title: Challenges in AI based tumor board case summarization and recommendations
zh_title: 基于AI的肿瘤多学科会诊病例总结与建议的挑战
summary: 在四家机构数据上评估多种LLM于肿瘤会诊病例总结、方案生成和会议结局预测任务，总结评分较高，建议生成更困难。
key_points: 肿瘤内科医生创建约9.6k参考文本、16k人工评判
评估DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini、Qwen系列模型
reason: 四机构数据、大规模专家评估，含人机对照，属重要档
abstract: Tumor boards, recurring meetings at hospital institutions, assemble cancer specialists (e.g., medical oncology and pathology) to discuss patient care. In this work, we formally define tumor board case summarization, options generation, and meeting outcome prediction as AI tasks. We study datasets from four medical institutions and evaluate state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) from the DeepSeek, GPT, Gemini, and Qwen families using expert human assessment. Medical oncologists created ~9.6k reference texts and 16k human judgments across tasks. Clinicians rated LLM-generated case summaries 3.57–4.59 out of 5.0 across institutions, but recommendation generation remained more challenging, with average scores of 2.0–3.6. Clinical alignment analyses showed modest correlations of ~0.2 for case summarization subtasks and higher correlations of ~0.6 for recommendation generation using LLM-as-Judge metrics. Our proposed TBFact metrics were competitive with LLM-as-Judge approaches in longer prose free-text settings, suggesting a promising direction toward explainable evaluation. This study, to our knowledge the largest expert-grading study of tumor board tasks with both granular and direct assessments, found that criterion-level scores and overall judgments are related nonlinearly. Experts also frequently assigned high ratings to responses that differed substantially from their reference texts, challenging assumptions underlying reference-based automatic evaluation metrics.
zh_abstract: 肿瘤多学科会诊（tumor board）是医院机构中定期召开的会议，汇集癌症专科医生（如肿瘤内科和病理科）讨论患者的诊疗。在本研究中，我们将肿瘤多学科会诊的病例摘要、备选方案生成和会议结果预测正式定义为人工智能任务。我们研究了来自四家医疗机构的数据集，并通过专家人工评估，对来自 DeepSeek、GPT、Gemini 和 Qwen 系列的最先进大语言模型（LLM）进行了评价。肿瘤内科医生在各项任务中共创建了约 9.6k 条参考文本和 16k 条人工评判。各机构的临床医生对 LLM 生成的病例摘要评分为 3.57–4.59（满分 5.0），但推荐意见生成仍更具挑战性，平均得分为 2.0–3.6。临床一致性分析显示，病例摘要各子任务的相关性较弱，约为 0.2；而使用 LLM-as-Judge 指标时，推荐意见生成的相关性较高，约为 0.6。我们提出的 TBFact 指标在较长的散文式自由文本场景中与 LLM-as-Judge 方法相比具有竞争力，提示了一个有前景的可解释评估方向。据我们所知，本研究是迄今规模最大的、同时包含细粒度评估和直接评估的肿瘤多学科会诊任务专家评分研究，发现标准层面的评分与总体评判之间呈非线性关系。专家还经常对与其参考文本差异很大的回答给予高分，这对基于参考文本的自动评估指标所依据的假设提出了挑战。

title: Multimodal AI-enabled repurposing and prioritization of ferroptosis-targeting drug combinations in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
zh_title: 多模态AI用于胰腺癌铁死亡靶向联合用药的重定位与优先排序
summary: FeNetDP整合多组学与临床生存数据，筛选胰腺导管腺癌中靶向铁死亡抑制程序的可重定位药物组合，并进行了前瞻性实验验证。
key_points: 定义八基因铁死亡抑制模块，与预后不良相关
结合网络邻近分析与生物约束神经排序模型
前瞻性实验验证了候选化合物
reason: 同行评审药物重定位，含实验验证，但属临床前，属值得一看档
abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) lacks scalable and mechanism-informed computational strategies for prioritizing repurposable drug combinations. Here, we developed FeNetDP, a multimodal AI-guided framework that integrates transcriptomic, proteomic, single-cell, spatial, and clinical survival data to enable biologically grounded drug repurposing and combination prioritization in PDAC. FeNetDP combines gene-level network proximity analysis with a biologically constrained neural ranking model to identify candidate compounds and drug pairs linked to a disease-relevant ferroptosis suppressor program. Using this framework, we defined an eight-gene ferroptosis suppressor module enriched in ductal cells and associated with poor prognosis, and prioritized candidate repurposable compounds and combinations targeting this network state. Prospective experimental validation identified panobinostat plus sorafenib as a synergistic combination that suppresses tumor growth and promotes ferroptosis in vitro and in vivo. Mechanistically, the combination impaired ferroptosis resistance through coordinated disruption of glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense and AIFM2 (FSP1)-associated glutathione-independent protection. Together, these findings establish FeNetDP as a multimodal and experimentally grounded framework for computational repurposing and mechanism-informed therapeutic prioritization in cancer.
zh_abstract: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）缺乏可扩展且基于机制的计算策略来优先筛选可重新利用的药物组合。在此，我们开发了 FeNetDP，这是一个多模态、由 AI 引导的框架，整合转录组、蛋白质组、单细胞、空间和临床生存数据，以实现 PDAC 中基于生物学的药物重新利用和联合用药优先排序。FeNetDP 将基因水平的网络邻近性分析与受生物学约束的神经网络排序模型相结合，以识别与疾病相关的铁死亡抑制程序相关的候选化合物和药物对。利用该框架，我们定义了一个在导管细胞中富集且与不良预后相关的八基因铁死亡抑制模块，并优先筛选出针对该网络状态的候选可重新利用化合物及其组合。前瞻性实验验证发现，帕比司他（panobinostat）联合索拉非尼（sorafenib）为一种协同组合，在体外和体内均可抑制肿瘤生长并促进铁死亡。机制上，该组合通过协同破坏谷胱甘肽依赖的抗氧化防御以及 AIFM2（FSP1）相关的非谷胱甘肽依赖保护，削弱了铁死亡抵抗。综上，这些发现确立了 FeNetDP 作为一个多模态且有实验依据的框架，可用于癌症中的计算药物重新利用和基于机制的治疗优先排序。

title: Generative fundus angiography from misaligned handheld images for non-invasive screening of infantile retinal diseases
zh_title: InfantAngio：用错位手持图像生成眼底血管造影
summary: 提出基于扩散的InfantAngio框架，将彩色眼底照到荧光造影的合成表述为确定性潜空间传输，用于婴幼儿视网膜疾病无创筛查。
key_points: 针对手持接触式相机的CFP与FFA空间错位
扩散式框架，确定性潜空间传输轨迹
目标是无创近似血管造影，避免荧光素
reason: 眼科生成式新方法，摘要未见外部验证细节，值得一看档
abstract: Infantile retinal diseases are a leading cause of childhood blindness, and vascular findings that guide screening and management are often poorly visible in color fundus photography (CFP). Fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA) provides angiographic visualization of retinal vascular abnormalities, but its invasive nature and reliance on fluorescein dye limit routine use in vulnerable infants. Generative synthesis may provide non-invasive angiographic approximations. However, infant imaging often relies on manually operated handheld contact fundus cameras, with variations in probe angle, contact pressure, and field of view between separate CFP and FFA acquisitions contributing to weak spatial correspondence between modalities. In this paper, we present InfantAngio, a diffusion-based framework that reformulates CFP-to-FFA synthesis as a deterministic latent transport trajectory. Developed and evaluated using 83,950 registration-derived image-pair records from 259 infants, InfantAngio showed favorable performance across quantitative image-quality benchmarks, while ophthalmologists distinguished real from synthesized FFA images with near-chance accuracy of 49.8% in blinded assessment. Adding synthesized FFA to CFP improved both downstream classifier performance and overall diagnostic accuracy in a retrospective ophthalmologist reader study. These results support synthesized FFA as a potentially useful non-invasive adjunct for screening high-risk infants, with the possibility of reducing reliance on dye-based procedures in real-world clinical scenarios.
zh_abstract: 婴儿视网膜疾病是儿童致盲的主要原因，而指导筛查和处理的血管表现在彩色眼底照相（CFP）中往往难以清晰显示。荧光素眼底血管造影（FFA）可对视网膜血管异常提供血管造影可视化，但其有创性及对荧光素染料的依赖限制了其在脆弱婴儿中的常规应用。生成式合成可能提供无创的血管造影近似图像。然而，婴儿成像常依赖人工操作的手持接触式眼底相机，分别采集的 CFP 与 FFA 之间探头角度、接触压力和视野存在差异，导致两种模态之间的空间对应较弱。本文提出 InfantAngio，一种基于扩散的框架，将 CFP 到 FFA 的合成重新表述为确定性的潜空间传输轨迹。InfantAngio 基于来自 259 名婴儿的 83,950 条配准衍生的图像对记录进行开发和评估，在定量图像质量基准上表现良好，而在盲法评估中，眼科医生区分真实与合成 FFA 图像的准确率为 49.8%，接近随机水平。在一项回顾性眼科医生读片研究中，在 CFP 基础上加入合成 FFA 同时提高了下游分类器性能和总体诊断准确率。这些结果支持将合成 FFA 作为筛查高危婴儿的一种潜在有用的无创辅助手段，并有望在真实临床场景中减少对基于染料的检查的依赖。

title: VoxelSlicer: Adaptive Voxel-wise Slicer for Deformable Image Registration.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: VoxelSlicer：用于可变形图像配准的自适应体素切片器
summary: 提出受双边网格启发、带可学习自适应滤波的神经网络模块，改善高形变结构与滑动、呼吸运动下的可变形配准。
key_points: 针对各向同性扩散正则化导致边界过平滑
体素级自适应滤波，处理位移场局部不连续
面向腹部跨受试者与心脏受试者内配准
reason: 有新意的配准方法，摘要未见外部验证细节
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] Recent progress in neural networks has accelerated deformable image registration (DIR) by amortizing iterative optimization, offering faster results and potential accuracy gains with label supervision. However, existing methods struggle with highly deformed structures (e.g., inter-subject abdominal or intra-subject cardiac scans) and fail to handle complex motions like sliding or respiratory dynamics. This limitation arises from isotropic diffusive pair-wise regularization, which leads to inefficient message passing and oversmoothed boundaries. We propose VoxelSlicer, a novel neural network module inspired by the traditional bilateral grid but enhanced with learnable adaptive filtering. VoxelSlicer enables voxel-wise adaptive filtering, addressing local discontinuities in displacement fields and performs more efficient message passing. This design enables adaptive displacement-cost propagation with a compact parameter footprint and a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off. Experiments on four realistic datasets and two synthetic datasets with different modalities and input constraints demonstrate VoxelSlicer's competitive registration performance together with favorable accuracy-complexity and accuracy-smoothness trade-offs.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 神经网络的最新进展通过摊销迭代优化加速了可变形图像配准（DIR），在有标签监督时可提供更快的结果并可能提高精度。然而，现有方法难以处理高度形变的结构（如受试者间腹部扫描或受试者内心脏扫描），也无法处理滑动或呼吸动力学等复杂运动。这一局限源于各向同性的扩散式成对正则化，导致信息传递效率低下和边界过度平滑。我们提出了 VoxelSlicer，这是一种新型神经网络模块，其灵感来自传统的双边网格（bilateral grid），并通过可学习的自适应滤波加以增强。VoxelSlicer 可实现逐体素的自适应滤波，解决位移场中的局部不连续问题，并实现更高效的信息传递。该设计能够以紧凑的参数量实现自适应的位移代价传播，并在精度与复杂度之间取得良好的权衡。在四个真实数据集和两个合成数据集（具有不同模态和输入约束）上的实验表明，VoxelSlicer 具有有竞争力的配准性能，并在精度-复杂度和精度-平滑度之间取得了良好的权衡。

title: Rapid comparative evaluation of 2 ambient artificial intelligence applications in a learning health system.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

summary: 在100名医生、90天内比较Abridge与Nabla，含整群随机交叉、EHR工作流分析和模拟问诊评估。
key_points: 两系统在模拟问诊中笔记要素准确率均为76%
整群随机交叉比较，Abridge可用性更高
评估满意度、效率、笔记质量与患者态度
reason: 随机交叉设计的部署评估，但单系统、规模有限
abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] To evaluate ambient Artificial Intelligence (AI) scribe systems (AAS) across multiple domains using a rapid learning health system (LHS) approach, including provider satisfaction, efficiency, documentation quality, usability, and patient sentiment. This LHS evaluation compared 2 AAS systems (Abridge and Nabla) among 100 providers over 90 days. Evaluation incorporated a cluster randomized crossover comparison, analysis of use and EHR-based workflow outcomes, and standardized simulated encounters to assess documentation quality and safety. Outcomes included provider satisfaction, efficiency, note quality, usability, and patient sentiment. In standardized simulated encounters, both systems achieved 76% note element accuracy with minimal risk for harm. In the randomized crossover comparison, Abridge demonstrated higher usability scores (78.5 vs 73) and was preferred 3:1 over Nabla, which had higher automated speech recognition error rates. Across 16 479 clinical encounters, AAS was used in 35.7% of visits. Total EHR time decreased by approximately 5 minutes per day; same-day chart closure increased by approximately 5% during the initial crossover period, but this effect was attenuated. Provider experience was positive (Net Promoter Score [NPS] 53). Both systems demonstrated comparable documentation accuracy and modest efficiency gains while improving clinician satisfaction. Despite similar performance, clinicians reported differences in usability and preference. Adoption below 40% reflected the trade-off between documentation support and verification burden. Rapid, multidimensional evaluation within a LHS can assess AAS across domains of implementation, efficiency, clinician experience, and documentation quality and safety. Ongoing monitoring of efficiency, documentation quality, and use patterns is essential.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 采用快速学习型健康系统（LHS）方法，从提供者满意度、效率、文书质量、可用性和患者态度等多个维度评估环境式人工智能（AI）记录系统（AAS）。本次 LHS 评估在 100 名提供者中比较了 2 种 AAS 系统（Abridge 和 Nabla），为期 90 天。评估包括整群随机交叉比较、使用情况及基于电子健康记录（EHR）的工作流程结局分析，以及用于评估文书质量和安全性的标准化模拟就诊。结局包括提供者满意度、效率、病历记录质量、可用性和患者态度。在标准化模拟就诊中，两个系统的病历要素准确率均为 76%，且造成伤害的风险极小。在随机交叉比较中，Abridge 的可用性得分更高（78.5 比 73），并以 3:1 的比例优于 Nabla，而 Nabla 的自动语音识别错误率更高。在 16 479 次临床就诊中，35.7% 的就诊使用了 AAS。EHR 总用时每天减少约 5 分钟；在最初的交叉期内，当日病历关闭率增加约 5%，但该效应随后减弱。提供者体验为正面（净推荐值 [NPS] 53）。两个系统的文书准确性相当，效率有适度提升，同时提高了临床医生满意度。尽管性能相近，临床医生报告在可用性和偏好方面存在差异。低于 40% 的采用率反映了文书支持与核查负担之间的权衡。在 LHS 内进行快速、多维度的评估，可以从实施、效率、临床医生体验以及文书质量和安全性等方面评估 AAS。对效率、文书质量和使用模式进行持续监测至关重要。

title: Tempering and few-shot calibration of pathology foundation models improve digital biomarker reproducibility across slide scanners
zh_title: 病理基础模型的调温与少样本校准提升跨扫描仪生物标志物复现性
summary: 一种基础模型微调方法，减少跨扫描仪预测差异，并在HPV、MSI、前列腺分级和乳腺表型上验证。
key_points: 跨扫描仪差异降低约63%–81%
前列腺分级一致性由42.5%升至92.7%
扫描仪混杂下HPV AUROC仅从0.86降至0.84
reason: 多任务多瘤种、方法清晰解决实际痛点，预印本上限内
abstract: Pathology foundation models underpin a growing number of histology-based cancer biomarkers, but sensitivity to slide scanner-specific image signatures degrades cross-center reliability and reproducibility. We developed a foundation model fine-tuning method that improved consistency in head-and-neck cancer human papillomavirus (HPV) prediction, colorectal cancer microsatellite instability (MSI) identification, prostate cancer grading and breast cancer phenotyping. This tempering method decreased cross-scanner prediction differences by 67.5% for HPV (95% CI 59.0-73.9%), 69.3% for MSI (95% CI 51.9-76.5%) and 63.4%-81.2% for breast signatures. Cross-scanner prostate grade agreement rose from 42.5% to 92.7%. Under full scanner-HPV confounding during training, AUROC fell from 0.80 to 0.68 with original model features but only from 0.86 to 0.84 with tempering. Unlike post hoc feature calibration, tempering used only public data yet matched or exceeded on-site calibration. These findings support tempering to reduce scanner dependence of pathology foundation models.
zh_abstract: 病理基础模型是越来越多基于组织学的癌症生物标志物的基础，但对玻片扫描仪特异性图像特征的敏感性会降低跨中心的可靠性和可重复性。我们开发了一种基础模型微调方法，提高了头颈癌人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）预测、结直肠癌微卫星不稳定性（MSI）识别、前列腺癌分级和乳腺癌表型分析的一致性。这种调校（tempering）方法使跨扫描仪预测差异在HPV中降低了67.5%（95% CI 59.0-73.9%），在MSI中降低了69.3%（95% CI 51.9-76.5%），在乳腺特征中降低了63.4%-81.2%。跨扫描仪的前列腺分级一致性从42.5%升至92.7%。在训练期间扫描仪与HPV完全混杂的情况下，使用原始模型特征时AUROC从0.80降至0.68，而使用调校后仅从0.86降至0.84。与事后特征校准不同，调校仅使用公开数据，却达到或超过了现场校准的效果。这些结果支持采用调校来降低病理基础模型对扫描仪的依赖。

key_points: 无需人工病灶标注，仅由报告监督学习定位

abstract: Artificial intelligence systems for computed tomography (CT) remain largely restricted to specific anatomical regions, examination types or predefined abnormalities, limiting their ability to provide comprehensive and spatially grounded interpretations. Here we present FORA, a general-purpose CT model that recognizes and spatially localizes 1,028 hierarchically organized radiological concepts and generates reports across the 28 CT protocols represented in our cohort. Trained on 304,962 routine CT examinations supervised by their accompanying reports, FORA learns to localize abnormalities without manually annotated lesions. Its architecture combines multiple-instance learning with an interpretable concept bottleneck that connects spatial evidence, radiological findings and report generation. We first developed and benchmarked the architecture on chest radiographs, achieving state-of-the-art performance, before training a separate model on three-dimensional CT examinations. On 36,619 held-out CT examinations, FORA achieved a macro area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.918 for radiological concept recognition, exceeding the strongest of 18 existing CT models by 0.21. FORA also ranked first on three public benchmarks, outperforming Merlin on its own test set without training on that institution's data (AUROC 0.907 versus 0.826). On independent localization benchmarks for pulmonary emboli, renal masses and rib fractures, FORA's strongest spatial evidence fell within annotated lesions at rates up to 348 times greater than chance. FORA achieved more than threefold higher macro-averaged finding recall than the strongest existing report generator. These results show that a single model can combine broad abnormality recognition, spatial localization and report generation across 12 CT examination types, using routine reports without lesion-level supervision.

abstract: Cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment decisions increasingly rely on integrating tissue morphology with specific molecular readouts of the tumor and its microenvironment. H&E histopathology provides scalable morphology, whereas multiplex spatial proteomics quantifies dozens of proteins in situ with spatial context, but remains selectively deployed, often with different marker panels across cohorts. This creates a translational bottleneck: most patients lack high-depth molecular profiling, and existing models rarely integrate morphology and spatial molecular data in a single framework. We present VirTues-M2, a multimodal foundation model that jointly learns from H&E and spatial proteomics using a novel vision transformer-based architecture. By encoding marker identity during pretraining, VirTues-M2 is robust to missing modalities, imperfect modality pairing or registration, and variable marker panels, enabling unified inference for tissue phenotyping, panoptic cell segmentation, virtual staining, annotation-free biomarker discovery, and reinforcement learning-based adaptive marker panel selection to reduce assay burden. As a concrete demonstration of translational utility, in a newly collected cohort of 1,053 treatment-naive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with paired spatial proteomics and H&E, VirTues-M2 discovers high-risk and low-risk tissue signatures that stratify overall survival in both the discovery cohort and an independent validation cohort, outperforming current state-of-the-art stratification schemes; all enabled by VirTues-M2's ability to jointly analyze both modalities within a single model.

abstract: Abnormal body composition at intensive care unit (ICU) admission is associated with worse survival, but it is rarely measured in practice because manual CT analysis is labor-intensive. We conducted a secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 patients who underwent chest CT within 24 h of ICU admission, of whom 475 were included in the final analysis. Open-source AI segmentation was used to quantify body composition, and the resulting features were related to 6-month survival. Risk scores derived from body composition were significantly associated with 6-month survival (p < 0.001, log-rank test). In five-fold cross-validation, the AUC for discriminating survivors from non-survivors was 0.73; when feature selection was accounted for, the AUC was 0.68 by nested cross-validation and 0.69 by bootstrap optimism correction. The study shows that the automated AI-based analysis of admission chest CT yields body composition scores significantly associated with 6-month mortality after ICU admission.

abstract: [Current Alzheimer research] Multimodal deep learning models are increasingly used to predict conversion from Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) to Alzheimer's Disease (AD), but their performance and methodological reliability remain uncertain. To evaluate the discriminative performance and risk of bias of multimodal deep learning models for longitudinal MCI-to-AD conversion prediction. PubMed, Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, the Cochrane Library, and Web of Science were searched from database inception through September 25, 2026. Eligible studies evaluated multimodal deep learning models for predicting longitudinal conversion from baseline MCI to AD or AD dementia and reported an AUC. Risk of bias and applicability were assessed using PROBAST+ AI. AUCs from independent external-validation cohorts were synthesized using a logit-scale random-effects meta-analysis. Internal-validation results were summarized descriptively because potential participant overlap across ADNI-derived cohorts could not be reliably determined. Nineteen studies were included. Eighteen studies reported internal-validation AUCs, which ranged from 0.747 to 0.962, with a median of 0.913 (IQR, 0.849-0.925). Five studies contributed independent external-validation results. The pooled external-validation AUC was 0.778 (95% CI, 0.709-0.835), with substantial heterogeneity (I² = 89.3%) and a 95% prediction interval of 0.615- 0.885. Fourteen studies were judged to be at high overall risk of bias. Internally validated discrimination was generally high, whereas performance in independent external cohorts was lower and more variable. Multimodal deep learning models show potential for MCI-to-AD risk stratification, but current evidence remains insufficient for routine clinical deployment. Independent, multicenter, and prospectively designed validation is needed.

abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Automated identification and extraction of recommendations for additional imaging (RAI) from radiology reports could facilitate closed-loop tracking and follow-up completion. We compare a prompt-engineered GPT-4.1 large language model (LLM) versus a validated encoder-only transformer deep learning model (bidirectional encoder representations from transformers [BERT]) for detection of RAI in abdominopelvic computed tomography (CTAP) reports, and evaluate GPT-4.1 for extraction of actionable RAI elements. This retrospective study included CTAP reports from a multi-institution system in 2023. LLM and BERT were used to identify RAI from radiology reports; LLM also extracted RAI actionable elements (modality, body part, time frame, rationale). Recall, precision, F1, and accuracy for RAI detection were determined using human-annotated reference standard. Paired comparison between each model's accuracy used McNemar's test. LLM recall, precision, F1, and accuracy for actionable element extraction were computed. Element prevalence was compared using chi-square test. 2000 random reports for unique patients (58% women; mean age 58.5 ± 17.5) included 215 RAI within 206 reports. For RAI detection, GPT-4.1 recall, precision, F1 and accuracy were 95.6%, 98.5%, 97.0% and 99.4%, respectively; BERT recall, precision, F1 and accuracy were 93.7%, 96.5%, 95.1% and 99.0% (p = 0.16). Recommendation element recall were as follows: 100.0% for time frame, 93.9% for body part, 90.2% for rationale, and 94.2% for modality. Precision were 100.0%, 95.7%, 94.6% and 86.1%, respectively. 29/215 (13.5%) RAI were complete (specified all actionable elements). Prevalence of actionable elements varied (p < 0.001), highest for rationale (215/215, 100%), followed by body part (213/215, 99.1%), modality (191/215, 88.8%), and time frame (31/215, 14.4%). GPT-4.1 demonstrated high accuracy for extraction of RAI and enabled accurate extraction of actionable elements. LLM integration into radiology workflows can facilitate automatic closed-loop communication and tracking of recommended imaging, which may reduce diagnostic delays.

abstract: [Cancer medicine] Regulatory T (Treg) cells contribute to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICIs) resistance in cancer, yet a systematic approach to capture their pan-cancer impact on treatment outcomes remains limited. We analyzed scRNA-seq data from ICI-treated patients to characterize Treg-related features, including patient-level Treg proportions and exploratory intra-Treg CIBERSORTx scores. Treg.Sig, a pan-cancer Treg-associated immune-microenvironmental signature, was then derived from pre-annotated Treg cells across 32 scRNA-seq datasets and further evaluated by patient-level pseudobulk sensitivity analyses. The signature's association with immunosuppression, intratumor heterogeneity (ITH), and total mutation burden (TMB) was assessed in the TCGA pan-cancer cohort. Building upon this signature, we applied and systematically compared seven machine learning and four deep learning algorithms across 10 ICIs-treated RNA-Seq cohorts to identify the optimal predictive model. Finally, 29 CRISPR datasets were analyzed to prioritize resistance-associated targets, with candidate genes validated by immunohistochemistry, qRT-PCR, and Western blot. Exploratory cell-level analyses showed lower intra-Treg CIBERSORTx scores in responders in both cohorts. In SKCM, patient-level analysis showed a higher Treg/CD4 T-cell proportion in non-responders, whereas broader Treg proportions did not differ by response. Treg.Sig was positively correlated with markers of immunosuppression, ITH, and TMB. The optimal Treg.Sig model achieved area under the receiver operator characteristic (ROC) curves (AUCs) of 0.74 and 0.72 in validation and test sets, respectively, and 0.61-0.87 in independent test sets, outperforming existing transcriptomic models in predicting ICIs response. Among Treg.Sig genes, five immune resistance-related genes were identified through CRISPR data; LYZ and C1QA were significantly downregulated in ICIs responders, as confirmed by multiple experimental approaches. We developed a pan-cancer Treg-associated immune-microenvironmental signature and, through systematic application of multiple machine-learning and deep-learning algorithms, established a predictive model for ICI-response stratification. These findings support the potential utility of Treg.Sig for treatment-response stratification and highlight candidate genes for further investigation in Treg-associated immune resistance.

abstract: [Clinical infectious diseases : an official publication of the Infectious Diseases Society of America] Artificial intelligence (AI) discourse in infectious disease (ID) has focused on benchmarking large language model chatbots against clinicians, a useful but narrowing inquiry. Agentic AI is a different paradigm: goal-directed systems that pursue clinical objectives over time, integrating data, invoking tools, monitoring results, and adapting without repeated prompting. This Viewpoint defines the anatomy of an agent, situates it within a 3-level framework (predictive, conversational, agentic), and examines how agents could transform 6 domains of ID practice: clinical care, antimicrobial stewardship, clinical microbiology, infection prevention and control, research, and epidemiology and pandemic preparedness. Individual components have proven value; integrated systems remain untested. No validated agentic system has been deployed in clinical ID; error propagation, algorithmic bias, cost, absent validation frameworks, undefined liability, and consequences for the workforce and its training must be addressed first. The ID community has a narrow window to shape these systems before decisions are made without it.

title: Decision-Native Multimodal Clinical Modeling via Anatomical Grounding and Confidence Calibration

summary: 提出面向三维CT的多模态模型，通过解剖引导的视觉压缩、直接候选预测和反事实置信度监督，改善校准与对无关区域的依赖。

abstract: Structured clinical decisions from volumetric computed tomography (CT) require anatomically grounded predictions and calibrated confidence estimates. However, existing 3D medical multimodal models often suffer from uncalibrated autoregressive decoding and shortcut reliance on irrelevant anatomical regions. We introduce Radev, a decision-native multimodal model that integrates anatomy-guided visual compression, direct candidate prediction, and counterfactual confidence supervision. To bridge global context with fine-grained slice details, a frozen 3D encoder extracts reusable organ-level features, which are dynamically selected by the query to attend to 2D slice features within predicted anatomical bounds. The resulting compact visual tokens enable the language backbone to estimate candidate probabilities in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding. We further propose Counterfactual-Calibrated Training (CCT) to compare predictions under intact and intervened organ representations. CCT encourages confidence to decrease when removing target-organ evidence degrades decision quality, while penalizing excessive confidence drops under unrelated-organ removal. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we construct CT-Verdict, a comprehensive benchmark spanning binary finding presence, multiple-choice questions, and ordinal severity assessment across both in-distribution and external cohorts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Radev significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both decision accuracy and confidence calibration, while generalizing robustly under distribution shifts. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/
zh_abstract: 基于容积式计算机断层扫描（CT）的结构化临床决策，需要有解剖学依据的预测以及经过校准的置信度估计。然而，现有的三维医学多模态模型常常存在自回归解码未校准，以及依赖无关解剖区域的捷径等问题。我们提出了 Radev，一种以决策为原生目标的多模态模型，它整合了解剖引导的视觉压缩、直接候选预测和反事实置信度监督。为了将全局上下文与精细的切片细节相连接，一个冻结的三维编码器提取可复用的器官级特征，并由查询动态选择这些特征，以关注预测解剖边界内的二维切片特征。由此得到的紧凑视觉 token 使语言骨干网络无需自回归解码，即可在单次前向传播中估计候选项概率。我们进一步提出反事实校准训练（Counterfactual-Calibrated Training，CCT），用于比较在完整器官表征与被干预器官表征下的预测。CCT 促使在移除目标器官证据导致决策质量下降时置信度随之降低，同时惩罚在移除无关器官时置信度的过度下降。为了便于严格评估，我们构建了 CT-Verdict，这是一个综合性基准，涵盖二分类的征象有无判断、多项选择题以及有序严重程度评估，并包括分布内队列和外部队列。大量实验表明，Radev 在决策准确性和置信度校准方面均显著优于最先进方法，并且在分布偏移下仍能稳健泛化。项目页面：https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/Radev/

title: BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles

abstract: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.
zh_abstract: 采用对比式图像-文本预训练的生物医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）的发展，一直由扩展到规模越来越大、越来越多样的图像-文本数据集所推动。除了扩大规模之外，还可以通过从现有数据中学习更丰富的表征来取得进一步进展。我们假设科学文献本身的结构提供了额外的监督来源：图、子图、图注和随附的文章文本编码了跨模态的丰富关系。然而，将它们视为相互独立的图像-文本对会忽略其间的关系。为解决这一局限，我们将这些结构关系纳入对比式图像-文本监督。我们保留精确的图像-文本匹配，同时对相关配对引入较弱的正监督，例如某个子图与其同级子图的图注。我们对相同内容类型的跨文章负样本加权，以促进更精细的区分。我们还利用视觉内容、原始图注以及提及该图的段落来丰富子图描述。将子图与这些描述配对，并将完整图与其原始图注配对，得到 Loom52M，这是一个包含 5240 万个图像-文本对、涵盖科学图表和生物医学图像的数据集。使用 Loom52M，BioLoom（DFN-2B）在来自 10 个领域 43 个数据集的 67 项零样本分类任务上取得 56.82% 的领域平衡平均准确率，而 MedPMC-CLIP 为 48.77%。在采用简明图注的 BioLoomBench 和 BioMedFlickr 上，其双向平均 Recall@1 分别为 63.20% 和 10.59%，而各自最强的被评估基线 BiomedCLIP 和 MedPMC-CLIP 分别为 46.37% 和 7.55%。代码、数据集、基准和模型可在 https://bioloom-clip.github.io/ 获取。

abstract: [Journal of medical imaging (Bellingham, Wash.)] Deep learning image reconstruction or restoration can produce visually high-quality images that may lack familiar visual cues of reliability. Diffusion posterior sampling (DPS) is a stochastic reconstruction algorithm capable of producing samples from the posterior distribution, offering a potential mechanism to communicate uncertainty and a representation of the posterior distribution to radiologists. We designed and conducted an observer study to evaluate whether displaying multiple DPS posterior samples improves task-based performance in human readers compared with displaying a single DPS sample. The observer study evaluated performance for a binary discrimination task involving spiculated and non-spiculated lung lesions. A total of 200 lung lesions were obtained from the Lung Image Database Consortium dataset, including 100 spiculated and 100 non-spiculated lesions. Computed tomography slices containing these lesions were treated as ground truth. Low-dose projection data were simulated and reconstructed using filtered backprojection and DPS. Six radiologists evaluated each case under four display conditions: low-dose filtered backprojection, a single DPS sample, a scrollable stack of 30 DPS samples, and a tiled display of the same 30 DPS samples. Observer performance was assessed using multi-reader multi-case receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, with Lung Image Database Consortium spiculation annotations used as ground truth. Reading time and reader confidence were also recorded. Pooled area under the ROC curves (AUCs) were 0.691 for low-dose filtered-backprojection (FBP), 0.713 for single-sample DPS, 0.750 for the scrollable stack, and 0.747 for the tiled display. Both multi-sample DPS displays improved pooled AUC relative to single-sample DPS at the 10% significance level. The better-performing multi-sample display was reader-dependent. Averaged over all readers, the scrollable stack and tiled displays increased average reading time by 34.6% and 55.8% relative to low-dose FBP, respectively. abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in clinical text processing, but their role in emergency departments (EDs) and ED-adjacent emergency care remains unclear because ED electronic health records (EHRs) are heterogeneous, time-critical, and safety-sensitive. abstract: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.

abstract: Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63 Dice points on four-fold KiTS23 cross-validation) and trigger-routed LeanNeXt+. The latter improves all 15 evaluated CT/MRI settings over nnU-Net and exceeds the 3.3 larger ResEnc-M on 12 of 15 benchmarks at 0.30 its parameter count. Relative to random sampling, one-shot LLM generation, and score-selected agent search, the loop shows how failure analysis can yield reusable design rules across modalities.
zh_abstract: 神经架构搜索和由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的进化方法常将评估简化为一个标量适应度分数，从而丢弃了能够解释设计为何成功或失败的失败案例。我们提出一种假设驱动的架构发现循环：LLM 智能体诊断结构化的错误模式，提出可证伪的假设，在冻结的 nnU-Net 流程下检验反事实对照，并将经验证的机制提炼为可执行的“触发条件—动作”规则。在八轮搜索中，该循环为三维医学图像分割识别出两条原则。第一，将计算量从高分辨率解码器重新分配到编码器中段，可在降低成本的同时保留薄层解剖结构的边界。第二，支持域受限的区域对比（support-confined region contrast）可解决嵌套解剖腔室之间的误差，并由依赖解剖结构的触发条件来选择该规则何时适用。这些原则产生了 LeanNeXt（相对于 nnU-Net，MACs 为 0.78，训练步耗时为 0.92；在 KiTS23 四折交叉验证中 Dice 提高 1.63 个点）以及由触发条件路由的 LeanNeXt+。后者在所评估的全部 15 个 CT/MRI 设置中均优于 nnU-Net，并在 15 个基准中的 12 个上超过大 3.3 倍的 ResEnc-M，而参数量仅为其 0.30 倍。相对于随机采样、单次 LLM 生成和按分数选择的智能体搜索，该循环展示了失败分析如何能够产生跨模态可复用的设计规则。

title: JECT: Addressing the Context Shortcut in Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for Chest CT
zh_title: JECT：解决胸部CT联合嵌入预测学习中的上下文捷径
summary: 预印本针对胸部CT的JEPA预训练中的“上下文捷径”，让放射报告既作为预测器条件又作为编码器目标，并采用分层三维编码器。
key_points: 指出小结节等病灶难以由周围解剖预测
报告兼作预测条件与掩码章节文本预测目标
使用分层三维编码器
reason: CT影像-报告预训练新方法，预印本，结果未见
abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures learn by predicting features of masked regions from visible context. In chest computed tomography, the findings that decide a diagnosis, such as a small nodule, are often not predictable from the surrounding anatomy. A hidden finding is then best predicted toward normal anatomy, and the prediction loss stops rewarding the encoder for representing it. We call this the context shortcut. Conditioning the predictor on the radiology report repairs the prediction, but in our setup the encoder gains little over image-only pretraining: the report supplies what the encoder never had to learn. JECT therefore gives the report two roles: a condition for the predictor and, through masked section-text prediction, a target for the encoder, which must predict the report's anatomical sections from the unmasked scan. A hierarchical three-dimensional encoder that predicts at every stage keeps this clinical content at every scale. In ablations, the text target improves classification and localization, while conditioning adds little to the encoder. Trained from scratch on 173k volumes, the recipe reaches the level of current computed tomography foundation models in classification, retrieval and nodule malignancy, and of task-specific models in lung-cancer risk prediction after fine-tuning. Conditioning still matters: its predictor can be reused, with no extra training, to show where a report sentence acts, changing most at the finding the sentence describes. Code and pretrained weights are available.
zh_abstract: 联合嵌入预测架构通过根据可见上下文预测被遮蔽区域的特征来进行学习。在胸部计算机断层扫描（CT）中，决定诊断的发现（如小结节）往往无法由周围解剖结构预测。被隐藏的发现因此最容易被预测为趋向正常解剖结构，预测损失也就不再激励编码器去表征它。我们将此称为上下文捷径（context shortcut）。以放射学报告作为预测器的条件可以修复该预测，但在我们的设置中，与仅使用图像的预训练相比，编码器获益甚微：报告提供的恰恰是编码器本不必学习的内容。因此，JECT 赋予报告两种角色：作为预测器的条件，并通过遮蔽章节文本预测，作为编码器的目标，即编码器必须根据未被遮蔽的扫描图像预测报告的解剖学章节。一个在每个阶段都进行预测的层次化三维编码器，使这种临床内容在每个尺度上都得以保留。在消融实验中，文本目标提升了分类和定位性能，而条件化对编码器的增益很小。该方案在 17.3 万个影像体积上从头训练，在分类、检索和结节恶性判断方面达到了当前 CT 基础模型的水平，在微调后的肺癌风险预测方面达到了任务专用模型的水平。条件化仍然重要：其预测器无需额外训练即可重复使用，以显示报告中某一句子作用于何处，变化最大之处正是该句子所描述的发现。代码和预训练权重已公开。

title: DiCT: Teaching X-ray Vision-Language Models to Reason via Imagining CT
zh_title: DiCT：通过想象CT教X光视觉语言模型推理
summary: 提出三阶段CT到X光推理迁移框架，用CT视觉语言模型引导X光模型，推理时无需CT重建即可获得3D感知推理。
key_points: CT VLM作为教师引导X光学生模型
推理时不需显式CT重建
三阶段渐进式迁移并区分观察与想象
reason: 新颖VLM方法预印本，摘要无结果细节，VLM主题加分
abstract: Diagnosing with X-rays often requires reasoning about the 3D locations of abnormalities and their spatial relationships to surrounding anatomical structures, yet such reasoning remains challenging due to the loss of spatial information in 2D projections. To address this challenge, we propose Dreaming in CT (DiCT), a three-stage progressive CT-to-X-ray reasoning transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model (VLM) to guide an X-ray VLM. Through this CT-guided transfer, the student acquires CT-informed 3D reasoning capabilities, enabling it to reason directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time. The framework begins with instruct the dreamer, which equips the X-ray student with initial CT-oriented reasoning capabilities and establishes a structured interface that distinguishes X-ray observations from CT imagination. Building on this structure, visualize the dream introduces CT-guided on-policy distillation (OPD), where the CT teacher selectively guides the X-ray student's reasoning trajectories to transfer 3D anatomical knowledge. Finally, manifest the dream adapts the acquired reasoning capabilities from digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) to real clinical X-rays. Experiments across two VLM backbones on 3D-RAD and ReXVQA demonstrate DiCT's effectiveness across radiological reasoning tasks, achieving a 1.66 percentage point improvement over a CT reconstruction-based baseline on 3D-RAD Abnormality Identification with 12.77$\times$ lower inference computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT.

title: A dataset of clinically similar image pairs from citation-linked case reports for medical image retrieval
zh_title: PMC-PaIR：基于病例报告引文的相似医学图像对数据集
summary: 利用引文链接和大模型分层问答，从5.6万篇病例报告构建8.6万对临床相似图像，用于医学图像检索；专家评估准确度高。
key_points: 含86,144对图像，来自56,013篇PMC病例报告
LLM生成并回答分层问题以匹配图像
专家认为图像对高度准确，找到的正确对数约为对照的两倍
reason: 较大规模新数据集的预印本，但缺少下游验证
abstract: Retrieving images of patients clinically similar to a given patient can support diagnosis, teaching and research. Training and evaluating retrieval systems requires knowing which images of different patients show the same finding, and existing datasets are small or narrow in scope. We construct PMC-PaIR, a dataset of 86,144 pairs of clinically similar images from 56,013 open-access PubMed Central case reports, which often document rare or challenging presentations. We develop an approach that follows citations, which often link case reports of similar patients. To determine what two linked cases share clinically, it prompts large language models to generate and answer hierarchical questions, from modality to diagnosis and findings, and to match images by caption using the answers. Experts find the pairs highly accurate, and this question-guided approach finds twice as many correct pairs as direct matching. Fine-tuning BiomedCLIP on PMC-PaIR improves retrieval in all modality, anatomy and diagnosis categories tested, for image-only queries and image queries with a short text naming the finding. We release the dataset and the automated pipeline, which can extend PMC-PaIR as new case reports are published.
zh_abstract: 检索与给定患者临床相似的患者图像可支持诊断、教学和研究。训练和评估检索系统需要知道不同患者的哪些图像显示相同的表现，而现有数据集规模较小或范围狭窄。我们构建了PMC-PaIR数据集，其包含来自56,013篇开放获取PubMed Central病例报告的86,144对临床相似图像，这些病例报告常记录罕见或具有挑战性的表现。我们开发了一种沿引用关系寻找的方法，引用常常连接相似患者的病例报告。为确定两个关联病例在临床上共有什么，该方法提示大语言模型生成并回答从检查方式到诊断和表现的层级式问题，并利用答案按图注匹配图像。专家评估认为这些图像对的准确性很高，且这种问题引导的方法找到的正确图像对数量是直接匹配的两倍。在PMC-PaIR上微调BiomedCLIP，可在所测试的所有检查方式、解剖部位和诊断类别中提升检索效果，无论是仅图像查询，还是图像加一段指明表现的简短文本的查询。我们发布该数据集和自动化流程，随着新病例报告的发表，该流程可扩展PMC-PaIR。

title: Right Destination, Wrong Journey: Synthetic Counseling Dialogues Miss Human Interactional Dynamics
zh_title: 终点正确、过程失真：合成咨询对话缺失人类互动动态
summary: 跨十个咨询数据集评估发现，合成对话终点合理，但恢复动态与逐轮响应性与真人存在差距。
key_points: 以轨迹为中心评估过程保真度
响应性在各模型与范式中均偏低
针对性生成干预可缩小部分差距
reason: 十个数据集的对比评估，心理健康LLM方向加分
abstract: LLM-generated counseling dialogues are increasingly used for training and evaluating mental-health systems, yet existing evaluations focus largely on response quality and final outcomes rather than how support unfolds over time. We conduct a trajectory-centered evaluation of process fidelity across ten human, reconstructed, and synthetic counseling datasets. Our results show that synthetic dialogues often reach plausible endpoints but differ from human support in recovery dynamics and turn-by-turn responsiveness. While generation design can shift global properties such as recovery timing and trajectory structure, contingent patient--counselor responsiveness remains consistently lower in fidelity across models and generation paradigms. Our experiments on controlled synthetic datasets show that targeted generation interventions can narrow the gap with real data on several trajectory-level measures, but do not fully recover interactional fidelity, with turn-level responsiveness remaining limited. We release three controlled synthetic datasets comprising 2,050 dialogues, together with annotations and the evaluation framework.
zh_abstract: 由大语言模型（LLM）生成的咨询对话越来越多地用于训练和评估心理健康系统，然而现有评估主要关注回应质量和最终结局，而非支持如何随时间展开。我们以轨迹为中心，在十个人类、重构和合成的咨询数据集上开展了过程保真度评估。结果表明，合成对话通常能达到看似合理的终点，但在恢复动态和逐轮响应性方面与人类支持存在差异。尽管生成设计可以改变恢复时间和轨迹结构等整体特性，但在不同模型和生成范式下，患者与咨询师之间的随情境而变的响应性在保真度上始终较低。我们在受控合成数据集上的实验表明，有针对性的生成干预可在若干轨迹层面的指标上缩小与真实数据的差距，但并不能完全恢复交互保真度，逐轮响应性仍然有限。我们发布了三个受控合成数据集（共2,050段对话），以及标注和评估框架。

title: PatientFlowSynth: Evaluating FHIR Agents with Matched Patient Charts
zh_title: PatientFlowSynth：用匹配病历评估FHIR智能体
summary: 提供来自225名合成患者的18000项任务，评估智能体在FHIR病历中处理缺失或冲突证据的能力。
key_points: 18个模板、四种证据状态
重执行检索程序验证参考答案
严格成功需标签与引用均正确
reason: 新基准，合成数据，是否公开未明
abstract: Agents that search patient charts must classify claims from retrieved records, including cases with missing or conflicting evidence. In Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), status fields can change how those records should be interpreted. PatientFlowSynth provides 18,000 tasks from 225 synthetic patients and 18 templates that hold the patient, question, and retrieval program fixed across chart variants representing four evidence states. Re-executing the program verifies each variant's reference answer, evidence sets, and search requirements. Strict success requires a completed response with correct labels and citations exactly matching an accepted evidence set retrieved during the episode. Where required, a tool response must also show a complete search at the specified scope. In a study using GPT-5.6 Luna and 225 synthetic patients (3,600 matched pairs), explicit Encounter-status guidance increased strict success from 40.7% to 51.3% (+10.6 percentage points; 95% patient-bootstrap confidence interval, 8.4 to 12.8). Among cases whose primary reference label was insufficient evidence, label agreement fell from 49.2% to 29.3%. A prespecified two-model replication reproduced both changes. Failed retrieval can mask interpretation errors by producing a correct insufficient-evidence label without examining the relevant records. Additional model comparisons showed that the benefit of guidance was model-dependent. Retrieval, citation, and classification should be evaluated separately.
zh_abstract: 检索患者病历的智能体必须对检索到的记录中的论断进行分类，包括证据缺失或相互矛盾的情形。在快速医疗互操作性资源（Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources，FHIR）中，状态字段会改变这些记录应如何解读。PatientFlowSynth 提供了来自 225 名合成患者和 18 个模板的 18,000 项任务，在代表四种证据状态的各病历变体中，保持患者、问题和检索程序不变。重新执行该程序可验证每个变体的参考答案、证据集和检索要求。严格成功要求给出完整的应答，标签正确，且引用与该过程中检索到的某一可接受证据集完全一致。在有要求时，工具响应还必须显示在指定范围内完成了完整检索。在一项使用 GPT-5.6 Luna 和 225 名合成患者（3,600 个匹配对）的研究中，明确的 Encounter 状态指引使严格成功率从 40.7% 提高到 51.3%（+10.6 个百分点；患者层面自助法 95% 置信区间为 8.4 至 12.8）。在主要参考标签为证据不足的病例中，标签一致率从 49.2% 降至 29.3%。一项预先设定的双模型重复研究再现了这两种变化。检索失败可能会掩盖解读错误：即使未检查相关记录，也会产生正确的证据不足标签。进一步的模型比较显示，指引的获益取决于模型。检索、引用和分类应分别进行评估。

title: Clinical3D-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Spatial Intelligence of Multimodal LLMs in Hospital Environments
zh_title: Clinical3D-Bench：评估多模态大模型在医院环境中的空间智能
summary: 预印本发布含3,368道题、373个病房布局的模拟基准，评估35个多模态大模型，最佳准确率53.6%，医生为79.0%。
key_points: 八类问题，配对场景测试证据敏感性
开源与闭源最佳分别为45.7%与53.6%
微调可改进，摘要未给出具体数值
reason: 新颖多模态LLM基准、含医生对照，但为模拟数据预印本
abstract: Spatial reasoning in hospitals requires tracking look-alike equipment, interpreting patient-relative directions, and judging passage widths, yet existing benchmarks provide limited coverage of these abilities. We introduce Clinical3D-Bench, a simulated benchmark with 3,368 questions of eight types on egocentric walkthroughs of 373 hospital-room layouts. Layouts follow hospital design guidelines, answers are computed from the 3D scenes, and paired scene states test whether models change their answers when relevant evidence changes. Videos are photorealistic, and ten physicians screened the layouts. Among 35 multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the best open and proprietary models reach 45.7% and 53.6% macro accuracy, against 40.8% for an answer prior and 79.0% for physicians on a subset, and 27 of 32 open models score below 40% on two-way patient-relative directions. Fine-tuning on Clinical3D-45K, our 44,750-question training set, lifts two MLLMs 16-20 points above the best proprietary model. 3D maps given to the fine-tuned MLLM as input go largely unused: replacing them with another video's, even when they are ground truth, barely changes its accuracy. The proposed GeoJeV instead lets the MLLM compute with 3D: it reconstructs a scene memory from each video, selects 3D operations and their arguments from the MLLM's question state, and adds their evidence to its option scores. It achieves the highest accuracy of all evaluated models, narrowing the gap to physicians.

title: Medical Image Segmentation Is Now Just Another Coding Task
zh_title: 医学图像分割如今只是又一项编码任务
summary: 四个现成编码智能体仅凭任务描述与标注数据，在CPU上数小时内为13项任务构建分割器，9项2D任务最佳程序达GPU训练nnU-Net约99%的Dice。
key_points: 无框架、无预训练权重、无人工介入
覆盖13项任务、四种成像模态
智能体检查自身预测渲染图以进一步改进
reason: 编码智能体用于分割，思路新颖、对比nnU-Net，但为预印本
abstract: For decades, every new medical image segmentation task has needed an expert, a dedicated architecture, and a framework such as nnU-Net. This is no longer the case: medical image segmentation is now just another coding task. Given only a task description, labeled data, and a CPU (with no segmentation framework, no pretrained weights, and no human in the loop), four off-the-shelf coding agents built segmenters for 13 tasks across four imaging modalities within hours, an ability that has emerged rather than been built. On the nine 2D tasks, their best programs reach 99% of the Dice of a GPU-trained nnU-Net. Like any code, a segmenter improves by being revised and checked, so we ask how far the same agents can improve their own segmentations and what unlocks further gains. On unseen cases there is no reference, so the agents inspect renderings of their own predictions: this alone lifts the worst tenth of cases by 0.09 Dice and cuts boundary error (HD95) by almost a quarter. Far more is within reach. Told the true Dice of each attempt, the same agents improve in all 14 matched pairs, rescue 85% of failed masks instead of 30%, and surpass the GPU-trained nnU-Net on average, by producing better masks rather than by choosing among them. What unlocks these gains is a quality signal, which neither visual inspection, nor more rounds, nor a quality estimator trained by the agents themselves yet supplies: we call this the quality blind spot. The ability to build and to repair is already present; the next advance will come not from another segmentation model, but from reference-free quality estimation that coding agents can call.

title: SurgGenesis: A Generative Surgical World Model for Future-Aware Surgical Understanding
zh_title: SurgGenesis：面向未来感知手术理解的生成式手术世界模型
summary: 预印本提出生成式手术世界模型SurgGenesis，在潜空间学习手术状态转移，作为手术数据引擎，缓解标注稀缺与长尾问题。
key_points: 基于视频扩散模型，采用三阶段渐进LoRA适配
融合内镜视觉先验、流程语义与空间运动线索
从未来预测等维度评估，而非仅看视觉保真度
reason: 手术世界模型新方法，命中偏好；预印本且摘要证据有限
abstract: Surgical scene understanding is constrained by data scarcity and long-tail class imbalance, as annotating surgical videos demands scarce clinical expertise while rare procedural events remain underrepresented. We tackle this through data generation and propose SurgGenesis, a generative surgical world model that learns future surgical state transitions in a latent space from visual observations and textual procedural descriptions, serving as a scalable surgical data engine. To adapt a large-scale video diffusion model to the data-scarce surgical domain without catastrophic forgetting, we introduce a three-stage progressive LoRA strategy that incrementally injects endoscopic visual priors, procedural semantics, and spatial motion cues. Rather than judging generation by visual fidelity alone, we validate SurgGenesis along two axes that separate a world model from a generic generator: (i) future-awareness, by comparing predicted futures against the real future through a GT-latent prediction gap and temporal-horizon analysis, and (ii) action-faithful usefulness, by checking that generated clips contain the commanded surgical triplet and that using them to rebalance long-tail events and drive downstream understanding (segmentation, triplet recognition, 3D reconstruction) yields action-specific gains. Conditioned futures therefore complement conventional long-tail sampling. Code: https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis
zh_abstract: 手术场景理解受到数据稀缺和长尾类别不平衡的制约：标注手术视频需要稀缺的临床专业知识，而罕见的手术事件的数据仍然不足。我们通过数据生成来应对这一问题，并提出 SurgGenesis，一种生成式手术世界模型，它从视觉观察和文本手术过程描述中在潜空间学习未来手术状态的转换，可作为可规模化的手术数据引擎。为使大规模视频扩散模型适应数据稀缺的手术领域而不发生灾难性遗忘，我们引入了三阶段渐进式 LoRA 策略，逐步注入内镜视觉先验、手术过程语义和空间运动线索。我们不仅以视觉保真度来评判生成效果，而是沿两个能将世界模型与通用生成器区分开的维度验证 SurgGenesis：（i）未来感知能力，即通过 GT 潜变量预测差距和时间跨度分析，将预测的未来与真实未来进行比较；（ii）动作忠实的有用性，即检查生成的片段是否包含所指令的手术三元组，并检验使用这些片段来再平衡长尾事件并驱动下游理解任务（分割、三元组识别、3D 重建）是否带来针对特定动作的增益。因此，条件化的未来生成可对传统的长尾采样形成补充。代码：https://zh-qr.github.io/SurgGenesis

abstract: Specialist medical vision-language models (VLMs) are strong within their specialties but hard to unify: their training data are often private, and independently developed specialists cannot be assumed to share an architecture. Deploying these large models separately is costly. We present HuluOPD, an on-policy distillation recipe that unifies heterogeneous specialists into one lightweight VLM using only unlabeled prompts, without requiring reference answers or the specialists' training data. The lightweight model answers each prompt, and the specialist of the prompt's modality supervises its response; a continuation-aligned cross-tokenizer loss makes this possible even when they differ in architecture and tokenizer. We apply HuluOPD to five specialists, for ultrasound, pathology, optical coherence tomography, fundus photography, and dental imaging. To distill and evaluate them, we build HuluOPDCorpus, 914k unlabeled prompts, and HuluOPDBench, 47k held-out test items, from over 90 public datasets, and score all models under one protocol on 132k test items, including third-party benchmarks. A single model with 10% of the five specialists' combined parameters retains 94% of their question-answering performance, and one with 2% retains 89%. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of unifying heterogeneous medical specialist VLMs without requiring their training data or a shared architecture.

abstract: A protein can engage multiple partners, making it challenging to disrupt disease-associated interactions while preserving others. We developed Bivexia, an AI agent that guides a multistage pipeline from discovery and de novo design through preclinical evaluation. Its decision rules are fixed in advance, and each prospective selection by the agent is cryptographically committed before testing. The objective is to discover small molecules that disrupt specified interactions of a target protein while preserving others. A compound advanced by Bivexia bound LAG-3 with nanomolar affinity and disrupted its interactions with tau and amyloid-{beta} while preserving binding to MHC class II and FGL1. It reduced tau and amyloid-{beta} burden in independent cohorts across two mouse models. The same rules gave three of nine hits on PrP and two of nine on LRP1, none in random controls. Our findings establish a framework for AI agents to pursue defined interaction selectivity across targets.

abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly used for structured prediction, yet their suitability for healthcare applications remains uncertain because predictive performance alone does not establish fairness, probabilistic reliability, or robustness. We developed a multidimensional benchmark to compare four TFMs: TabFM, TabPFN, TabDPT, and TabICL, against Logistic Regression and XGBoost across a curated, standardized suite of ten WHO-aligned healthcare classification datasets across diverse disease domains. Additionally, we harmonized clinical schemas, standardized protected sex attributes and outcome targets, and released both balanced-scale and natural-prevalence variants of the datasets to establish a benchmarking resource in healthcare machine learning. All models were evaluated using identical five-fold stratified cross-validation partitions and standardized preprocessing. Performance was assessed using 20 metrics spanning predictive discrimination, sex-based fairness, probability calibration, and robustness to Gaussian feature perturbations. A composite Clinical Model Evaluation Score (CMES) was used to summarize performance across these dimensions. Google TabFM achieved the highest mean CMES (0.8811), followed closely by TabDPT (0.8796), TabICL (0.8775), TabPFN (0.8756), XGBoost (0.8650), and Logistic Regression (0.8549). The Friedman test indicated significant differences among models ({chi}2F (5) = 24.914, p = 1.45 x 10^-4; Kendalls W = 0.498). However, post-hoc comparisons revealed no statistically significant differences among the four TFMs after Holm correction. TFMs generally demonstrated stronger discrimination and probabilistic calibration than conventional baselines, with TabFM achieving the highest mean Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (0.9327) and the lowest expected calibration error (0.0674). Conversely, Logistic Regression exhibited the greatest stability under feature perturbations, while fairness performance varied substantially across datasets and models. These findings highlight the potential of TFMs for small-data healthcare prediction while demonstrating that their advantages are dimension-dependent. Multidimensional, dataset-specific evaluation and external validation remain essential before clinical implementation. All analysis codes, original datasets, and multiple variants of benchmark datasets are publicly available in a GitHub repository to ensure reproducibility and future research.

abstract: [Journal of cancer education : the official journal of the American Association for Cancer Education] Patients and caregivers increasingly consult large language model (LLM) chatbots for glioma-related information. Explaining glioma requires discussion of tumor classification, molecular pathology, treatment, and prognosis, making accurate patient education challenging. However, the quality of glioma-related information generated by LLMs has not been systematically evaluated. To compare the quality, transparency, and readability of glioma-related information generated by four publicly accessible LLM chatbots and assess whether their responses meet recommended readability standards for patient education. In this cross-sectional study, Google Trends was used to identify commonly searched glioma-related topics. Seventeen patient-oriented questions derived from 19 search terms were submitted to ChatGPT 5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Microsoft Copilot, and Perplexity. Two independent reviewers assessed response quality using DISCERN, Ensuring Quality Information for Patients (EQIP), the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) benchmark criteria, and the Global Quality Score (GQS). Readability was evaluated using six validated indices. Group differences were analyzed with the Kruskal-Wallis test followed by Dunn-Bonferroni post hoc comparisons. Significant differences were observed among the four chatbots for DISCERN (P = 0.001), EQIP (P < 0.001), JAMA (P < 0.001), and GQS (P = 0.022). Copilot achieved the highest DISCERN and EQIP scores, whereas ChatGPT received the highest GQS. Copilot and Perplexity demonstrated better transparency than ChatGPT and Gemini, although overall transparency remained limited. None of the chatbots met recommended readability standards for patient education. Publicly accessible LLM chatbots can provide structured glioma-related information, but performance varies across platforms. Limited transparency and poor readability restrict their suitability as stand-alone patient education tools. Improvements in evidence attribution, guideline-based retrieval, uncertainty communication, and plain-language adaptation are needed before routine use in neuro-oncology.

abstract: [Anatolian journal of cardiology] Accurate non-invasive localization of premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) is important for preprocedural planning before catheter ablation. Most artificial intelligence-based electrocardiography (ECG) models evaluate ectopic beats without incorporating patient-specific baseline ventricular conduction patterns. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a patient-referenced, QRS-centered deep learning framework integrating paired sinus rhythm and PVC 12-lead ECG recordings for binary localization of ventricular ectopic origin and to assess the incremental value of sinus rhythm information compared with PVC-only input. This retrospective, single-center diagnostic accuracy study included 270 patients with paired sinus rhythm and PVC ECG recordings and procedurally confirmed ventricular ectopic origin. Raw ECG signals were segmented using annotated QRS boundaries and aligned using a QRS-centered strategy. Three input strategies were evaluated: paired PVC + sinus rhythm, PVC-only, and sinus rhythm-only. A 1-dimensional residual convolutional neural network (CNN) (1D ResNet) and a 2-dimensional time-domain CNN (2D time-domain CNN) were trained directly on raw ECG waveforms, with late-fusion probability averaging used for ensemble predictions. Performance was assessed using 5-fold patient-level cross-validation. The primary endpoint was the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). For paired PVC + sinus rhythm input, pooled AUROC values were 0.753 for the 1D ResNet, 0.743 for the 2D time-domain CNN, and 0.762 for the late-fusion ensemble, with no statistically significant differences among architectures. In the cross-input comparison, ensemble AUROC was 0.762 for paired PVC + sinus rhythm, 0.731 for PVC-only, and 0.551 for sinus rhythm-only input. Paired PVC + sinus rhythm significantly outperformed PVC-only input (DeLong P = .0313), whereas sinus rhythm alone showed limited discrimination. Patient-specific sinus rhythm information provided incremental discriminatory value when combined with PVC morphology for binary left ventricular-right ventricular (LV-RV) localization, while sinus rhythm alone had limited discriminatory value. These findings provide proof-of-concept evidence supporting paired sinus rhythm-PVC modeling as a physiologically informed approach to ventricular ectopic localization. External validation and comparison with established ECG-based localization criteria are required before clinical implementation.
zh_abstract: [Anatolian journal of cardiology] 准确的无创室性早搏（PVC）定位对导管消融术前规划非常重要。大多数基于人工智能的心电图（ECG）模型在评估异位搏动时并未纳入患者特异性的基线心室传导模式。本研究旨在开发并评估一种以患者自身为参照、以 QRS 为中心的深度学习框架，该框架整合配对的窦性心律与 PVC 12 导联 ECG 记录，用于心室异位起源的二分类定位，并评估与仅使用 PVC 输入相比，窦性心律信息的增量价值。这项回顾性、单中心诊断准确性研究纳入了 270 例具有配对窦性心律和 PVC ECG 记录且心室异位起源经操作证实的患者。原始 ECG 信号根据标注的 QRS 边界进行分段，并采用以 QRS 为中心的策略对齐。评估了三种输入策略：配对 PVC + 窦性心律、仅 PVC、仅窦性心律。一维残差卷积神经网络（CNN）（1D ResNet）和二维时域 CNN（2D time-domain CNN）直接在原始 ECG 波形上训练，并采用后期融合概率平均进行集成预测。性能通过 5 折患者水平交叉验证进行评估。主要终点为受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）。对于配对 PVC + 窦性心律输入，1D ResNet 的汇总 AUROC 为 0.753，2D time-domain CNN 为 0.743，后期融合集成为 0.762，各架构之间差异无统计学意义。在不同输入的比较中，集成模型的 AUROC 在配对 PVC + 窦性心律为 0.762，仅 PVC 为 0.731，仅窦性心律为 0.551。配对 PVC + 窦性心律显著优于仅 PVC 输入（DeLong P = .0313），而仅窦性心律的区分能力有限。在左心室-右心室（LV-RV）二分类定位中，患者特异性窦性心律信息与 PVC 形态结合时提供了增量的区分价值，而单独使用窦性心律的区分价值有限。这些发现为配对窦性心律-PVC 建模作为一种符合生理学的心室异位定位方法提供了概念验证证据。在临床应用之前，需要进行外部验证并与已确立的基于 ECG 的定位标准进行比较。

abstract: [Otolaryngology--head and neck surgery : official journal of American Academy of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery] To compare the quality of patient-facing thyroid cancer information generated by clinicians, large language models (LLMs), and web search results using parallel expert and layperson evaluation under blinded conditions. Blinded comparative evaluation study. Online, text-based assessment of patient-facing health information. Thirty commonly searched thyroid cancer questions were identified using Google Trends. For each question, patient-facing answers were generated by a fellowship-trained head and neck surgeon, 5 widely used LLMs (GPT-4, GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek), and the first nonsponsored Google search result. Responses were anonymised and source-blinded. Seven attending physicians evaluated responses using the Quality Analysis of Medical AI (QAMAI) framework across 5 domains, and 15 lay participants evaluated the same responses across 4 patient-centred domains. Ratings were analysed at the question level using intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC), Friedman tests, Kendall's W, and post-hoc Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Expert inter-rater reliability was good across domains (ICC 0.78-0.82). Expert ratings differed significantly across sources (P < .001; Kendall's W = 0.70-0.81), with Claude achieving the highest expert scores and Google-derived responses the lowest. Layperson ratings also differed significantly (P < .001; Kendall's W = 0.70-0.87) but clustered near the upper end of the scale, indicating a ceiling effect. The largest expert-rated differences occurred for treatment-related questions, particularly radioactive iodine therapy. Patient-facing thyroid cancer information quality varies across clinicians, LLMs, and web search results. Divergence between expert and layperson assessments indicates that perceived clarity and reassurance do not reliably reflect expert-defined completeness or clinical robustness.

abstract: [FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology] Preeclampsia (PE) is a heterogeneous pregnancy disorder characterized by placental dysfunction and immune dysregulation. Translation of transcriptomic biomarkers has been limited by inconsistent feature selection, inadequate external validation, and poor model interpretability. We developed an explainable, externally validated, transcriptomics-driven artificial intelligence framework for biomarker discovery, PE diagnosis, and exploratory severity stratification. Placental transcriptomic datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus. Differential expression analysis and weighted gene co-expression network analysis were integrated with consensus feature selection using Elastic Net, LASSO, SVM-RFE, and Boruta. Selected biomarkers were evaluated using conventional machine learning, deep learning, ensemble, and hybrid models with repeated stratified cross-validation and independent cross-platform external validation. Model performance and interpretability were assessed using ROC and precision-recall analyses, DeLong's test, permutation testing, SHAP, and permutation importance. Integrative analyses identified 166 candidate genes and prioritized a six-gene signature comprising CGB5, LEP, LIMCH1, LRRC1, PAPPA2, and SIGLEC6. Logistic Regression achieved the highest external performance (ROC-AUC: 0.8516, 95% CI: 0.7913-0.9119; PR-AUC: 0.8572). DeLong's test showed no significant differences from the best-performing deep or hybrid models. Explainability analyses consistently identified LEP, LRRC1, PAPPA2, and SIGLEC6 as major predictive contributors. Exploratory early versus late-onset PE stratification achieved an ROC-AUC of 0.7617. The proposed framework identified a reproducible six-gene placental signature with robust cross-platform predictive performance and biological interpretability. Integrating consensus biomarker selection, external validation, and explainable artificial intelligence may facilitate the reproducible development of transcriptomic biomarkers for precision medicine in PE.
zh_abstract: [FASEB journal : official publication of the Federation of American Societies for Experimental Biology] 子痫前期（PE）是一种以胎盘功能障碍和免疫失调为特征的异质性妊娠疾病。转录组生物标志物的转化应用一直受限于特征选择不一致、外部验证不足以及模型可解释性差。我们开发了一个可解释、经外部验证、由转录组驱动的人工智能框架，用于生物标志物发现、PE诊断以及探索性的严重程度分层。胎盘转录组数据集来自 Gene Expression Omnibus。将差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析与采用 Elastic Net、LASSO、SVM-RFE 和 Boruta 的共识特征选择相整合。所选生物标志物采用传统机器学习、深度学习、集成及混合模型进行评估，并采用重复分层交叉验证和独立的跨平台外部验证。模型性能和可解释性通过 ROC 和精确率-召回率分析、DeLong 检验、置换检验、SHAP 以及置换重要性进行评估。整合分析鉴定出 166 个候选基因，并优选出由 CGB5、LEP、LIMCH1、LRRC1、PAPPA2 和 SIGLEC6 组成的六基因特征。逻辑回归（Logistic Regression）取得了最高的外部验证性能（ROC-AUC：0.8516，95% CI：0.7913–0.9119；PR-AUC：0.8572）。DeLong 检验显示其与表现最佳的深度学习或混合模型之间无显著差异。可解释性分析一致认为 LEP、LRRC1、PAPPA2 和 SIGLEC6 是主要的预测贡献因子。早发型与晚发型 PE 的探索性分层取得了 0.7617 的 ROC-AUC。所提出的框架鉴定出一个可重复的六基因胎盘特征，具有稳健的跨平台预测性能和生物学可解释性。将共识生物标志物选择、外部验证和可解释人工智能相结合，可能有助于推动 PE 精准医学中转录组生物标志物的可重复开发。

abstract: [Polski merkuriusz lekarski : organ Polskiego Towarzystwa Lekarskiego] Aim: To examine whether clinician authorization is an effective and sufficient safeguard when artificial intelligence influences treatment choices or drug prescribing. Materials and Methods: Purposively selected English-language empirical studies (January 2021 to August 2026; PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, SSRN, and ResearchGate, supplemented by reference lists) were synthesized descriptively alongside a comparative analysis of European Union and United States legislation and guidance. The review does not claim systematic coverage. Generative artificial intelligence was used only to assist source identification and revision. Conclusions: The proposed Meaningful Human Clinical Control test assesses reviewability, competence, time, authority, independent clinical justification, and traceability. These normative domains have no validated scoring method; their purpose is to identify remediable restrictions on clinical review. Liability still depends on the rules on defect, fault, and causation. A signature shows who authorized a prescription, not what that authorization involved.

abstract: [Reproductive sciences (Thousand Oaks, Calif.)] Can an AI-driven clinical decision support system reliably support clinical decision making across all steps of assisted reproductive technology (ART) work-up?. This study evaluates Fertility Oriented Expert (FOX), an AI-driven system designed for all steps of ART. FOX incorporates 3,998 full-text, open-access reproductive medicine publications (January 2000 - September 2025) with commercial large language models (LLMs) using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Thirty-two clinical questions covering ART pathway were used to evaluate the system. Responses generated by different FOX models were compared. Three common clinical cases with key diagnostic clues were presented to the FOX-GPT-5 to analyze further if the system could identify these clues and recommend a management plan. Finally, the responses generated by traditional GPT models were compared with the ones generated by FOX. Performance was assessed using G-score and semantic score, with statistical comparison via the Friedman rank-sum. Median G-scores showed no statistically significant differences between the models (0.8 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.8 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.95 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.21). Median semantic scores were also similar (0.89 for FOX-GPT-5, 0.89 for FOX-GPT-4o, and 0.9 for FOX-GPT-o1; P = 0.56. For clinical cases, FOX recommended appropriate treatment options, achieving high G-scores and semantic scores (G-score: 1-1; semantic score: 0.88-0.93). GPT models achieved high G-scores and semantic scores based on FOX model answers (G-score: 0.8-1; semantic score: 0.75-0.99) without statistically significant differences between the different GPT models (G-score P = 0.36; semantic score P = 0.65). FOX provides evidence-based information, covering ART pathway, providing clinical decision-making support for fertility specialists.
zh_abstract: [Reproductive sciences (Thousand Oaks, Calif.)] 人工智能驱动的临床决策支持系统能否在辅助生殖技术（ART）诊疗的各个环节可靠地支持临床决策？本研究评估了 Fertility Oriented Expert（FOX），这是一个面向 ART 全部环节设计的人工智能驱动系统。FOX 采用检索增强生成（RAG），将 3,998 篇全文开放获取的生殖医学文献（2000年1月至2025年9月）与商用大语言模型（LLM）相结合。研究使用覆盖 ART 全流程的 32 个临床问题对该系统进行评估，并比较了不同 FOX 模型生成的回答。向 FOX-GPT-5 提供三个带有关键诊断线索的常见临床病例，以进一步分析该系统能否识别这些线索并推荐处理方案。最后，将传统 GPT 模型生成的回答与 FOX 生成的回答进行比较。采用 G-score 和语义评分（semantic score）评估性能，并通过 Friedman 秩和检验进行统计学比较。各模型的 G-score 中位数差异无统计学意义（FOX-GPT-5 为 0.8，FOX-GPT-4o 为 0.8，FOX-GPT-o1 为 0.95；P = 0.21）。语义评分中位数也相近（FOX-GPT-5 为 0.89，FOX-GPT-4o 为 0.89，FOX-GPT-o1 为 0.9；P = 0.56）。对于临床病例，FOX 推荐了恰当的治疗方案，G-score 和语义评分均较高（G-score：1-1；语义评分：0.88-0.93）。以 FOX 模型的回答为基准，GPT 模型获得了较高的 G-score 和语义评分（G-score：0.8-1；语义评分：0.75-0.99），不同 GPT 模型之间差异无统计学意义（G-score P = 0.36；语义评分 P = 0.65）。FOX 可提供涵盖 ART 全流程的循证信息，为生殖专科医师提供临床决策支持。

abstract: [Skeletal radiology] Effective application of artificial intelligence (AI) in musculoskeletal (MSK) radiology depends on targeting unmet clinical needs rather than technical feasibility. This Society of Skeletal Radiology (SSR) position statement identifies and prioritizes the most impactful AI applications and value propositions for MSK radiologists. The SSR AI Committee (n = 18) used structured brainstorming to compile lists of AI-based applications and value propositions. After deduplication, standardization, and categorization using a 12-component MSK radiology value cycle, refined lists were distributed as electronic surveys to 122 SSR committee members; 103 (84.4%) and 102 (83.6%) completed the applications and value propositions surveys, respectively, scoring each item on a 5-point Likert scale. Top 10 lists were generated from summed scores. Brainstorming generated 208 AI application and 126 value proposition ideas, condensed to 138 and 56 unique items, respectively. Fourteen AI applications and 13 value propositions shared the top 10 ranks (tied scores). Top-ranked AI applications were within dictation and reporting (5 items), archiving and presentation (2), diagnostic imaging (1), follow-up imaging (2), quality/safety (2), and protocoling (2). Top-ranked value propositions were within dictation and reporting (4), diagnostic imaging (3), ordering (3), protocoling (2), and quality/safety (1). The highest-ranked application was AI-assisted comparison study retrieval (mean 3.17/4.0) and the highest-ranked value proposition was increased reporting efficiency (mean 3.30/4.0). This position statement provides a demand-driven roadmap for AI development in MSK radiology. Workflow and reporting tools were prioritized over disease detection algorithms, highlighting a gap between clinical needs and current commercial AI offerings.
zh_abstract: [Skeletal radiology] 人工智能（AI）在肌肉骨骼（MSK）放射学中的有效应用，取决于针对尚未满足的临床需求，而非技术可行性。本骨骼放射学会（SSR）立场声明确定并排序了对MSK放射科医师最具影响力的AI应用和价值主张。SSR AI委员会（n = 18）采用结构化头脑风暴，汇总了基于AI的应用和价值主张清单。经去重、标准化，并按12个组成部分的MSK放射学价值循环进行归类后，将精炼后的清单以电子问卷形式发送给122名SSR委员会成员；分别有103人（84.4%）和102人（83.6%）完成了应用问卷和价值主张问卷，对每一项按5分Likert量表评分。根据得分总和生成前10名清单。头脑风暴共产生208条AI应用和126条价值主张的想法，分别精简为138项和56项独特条目。14项AI应用和13项价值主张并列进入前10名（得分相同）。排名靠前的AI应用分属：听写与报告（5项）、归档与呈现（2项）、诊断成像（1项）、随访成像（2项）、质量/安全（2项）和方案制定（2项）。排名靠前的价值主张分属：听写与报告（4项）、诊断成像（3项）、检查申请（3项）、方案制定（2项）和质量/安全（1项）。排名最高的应用是AI辅助的对比检查检索（均值3.17/4.0），排名最高的价值主张是提高报告效率（均值3.30/4.0）。本立场声明为MSK放射学中AI的开发提供了需求驱动的路线图。工作流程和报告工具的优先级高于疾病检测算法，凸显了临床需求与当前商业AI产品之间的差距。

title: Can LLM Judges Catch Unsafe Clinical Actions? A Fault-Injection Study

abstract: As clinical AI agents begin to interact with electronic health records (EHRs), large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to evaluate their actions. But how reliably can these judges recognize clinically dangerous mistakes, especially when an agent appears to have completed its task successfully? We investigate this question using MedAgentBench by introducing controlled clinical errors into verified agent trajectories. The experiments include 416 faulty trajectories, eight error categories, and six open-weight LLM judges. By comparing each faulty trajectory with its correct counterpart, we measure whether judges genuinely recognize errors rather than simply flagging more actions as unsafe. The findings show that access to clinical evidence significantly improves judge reliability. When shown only the final answer, judges cannot distinguish errors that leave it unchanged, while flagging 56% of correct trajectories. With full trajectory information, the ability to distinguish unsafe actions from correct ones reaches a score of 0.75, and providing actual EHR responses improves discrimination by 0.39. Surprisingly, including the agent's reasoning does not improve overall performance and reduces detection of incorrectly reported clinical values by 0.18, which remain the hardest errors to detect. MedGemma performed worse than the general-purpose model and was the only judge to miss potentially dangerous medication overdoses. We also find that the benchmark's original grader accepts all 38 trajectories with an intentionally skipped laboratory check, while combining LLM judges with a rule-based checker informed by the full EHR record detects 97% of injected faults.
zh_abstract: 随着临床AI智能体开始与电子健康记录（EHR）交互，大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于评估其行为。但这些评判者识别具有临床危险性的错误的可靠性如何，尤其是在智能体看似成功完成任务时？我们利用MedAgentBench，通过在已验证的智能体轨迹中引入受控的临床错误来研究这一问题。实验包括416条存在错误的轨迹、8类错误以及6个开放权重LLM评判者。通过将每条错误轨迹与其正确对应轨迹进行比较，我们衡量评判者是否真正识别了错误，而不是仅仅将更多行为标记为不安全。结果显示，获取临床证据可显著提高评判者的可靠性。当仅提供最终答案时，评判者无法区分那些不改变最终答案的错误，同时会将56%的正确轨迹标记为有问题。在提供完整轨迹信息时，区分不安全行为与正确行为的能力得分达到0.75，而提供实际的EHR响应可使区分能力提高0.39。出人意料的是，纳入智能体的推理过程并未改善总体表现，并使对错误报告的临床数值的检出率降低0.18，而这类错误仍是最难检测的。MedGemma的表现不如通用模型，并且是唯一漏检潜在危险药物过量的评判者。我们还发现，该基准原有的评分器接受了全部38条有意跳过实验室检查的轨迹，而将LLM评判者与基于完整EHR记录的规则检查器相结合，可检出97%的注入错误。
