abstract: [Applied clinical informatics] Background Effective communication in the ICU is essential, yet timely access to professional interpreters remains challenging for patients with non-English language preference. Language discordance in high-acuity settings has been associated with miscommunication, delays in care, and adverse outcomes. Speech-based artificial intelligence (AI) interpretation tools have emerged as potential adjuncts to bridge communication gaps, but comparative usability data in high-stakes clinical settings remain limited. Objective To evaluate and compare clinician-reported usability of three speech-based AI interpretation tools during physician-led simulated ICU family meetings. Methods We conducted a comparative study involving 21 ICU physicians. Each participant completed three simulated ICU family meetings representing high-stakes scenarios including ECMO discussion, tracheotomy planning, and transition to comfort care. Participants were assigned to one non-English language (Spanish, Chinese, or Arabic) and used three speech-based interpretation tools (AI-TransLATE, ChatGPT, and Gemini) in counterbalanced order. After each encounter, clinicians completed the System Usability Scale (SUS) and structured Likert-scale assessments of satisfaction, perceived communication effectiveness, effort, and acceptability. Results AI-TransLATE achieved a median SUS of 70.0 (IQR 64.4-75.6) and ChatGPT 72.5 (IQR 70.0- 75.0), both meeting the acceptable threshold (≥70). Gemini received 40.0 (IQR 25.0-57.5), falling below the acceptable range. Gemini differed significantly from both AI-TransLATE and ChatGPT, while AI-TransLATE and ChatGPT did not differ significantly. Satisfaction, perceived communication effectiveness, and willingness to use in clinical practice were also significantly higher for AI-TransLATE and ChatGPT compared with Gemini. Conclusion In simulated ICU family meetings, select speech-based AI interpretation tools demonstrated acceptable clinician-reported usability, supporting further investigation of their potential as complementary interpretation tools when professional interpreter access is limited. Future work should prioritize validation and evaluation of patient understanding in real-world settings , to support safe and scalable implementation.
zh_abstract: [应用临床信息学]【背景】ICU 内的有效沟通至关重要，但对于偏好使用非英语语言的患者，及时获得专业口译员仍然困难。高急症场景中的语言不一致与沟通不良、诊疗延误和不良结局相关。基于语音的人工智能（AI）口译工具已成为弥合沟通差距的潜在辅助手段，但在高风险临床场景中的可用性比较数据仍然有限。【目的】评估并比较临床医生报告的三种基于语音的 AI 口译工具在医生主导的模拟 ICU 家属会议中的可用性。【方法】我们开展了一项纳入 21 名 ICU 医生的比较研究。每名参与者完成三场模拟 ICU 家属会议，涵盖 ECMO 讨论、气管切开计划和转为舒适照护等高风险情景。参与者被分配一种非英语语言（西班牙语、中文或阿拉伯语），并以平衡顺序使用三种基于语音的口译工具（AI-TransLATE、ChatGPT 和 Gemini）。每次会谈后，临床医生完成系统可用性量表（SUS），以及关于满意度、感知的沟通效果、付出的努力和可接受性的结构化 Likert 量表评估。【结果】AI-TransLATE 的 SUS 中位数为 70.0（IQR 64.4–75.6），ChatGPT 为 72.5（IQR 70.0–75.0），均达到可接受阈值（≥70）。Gemini 为 40.0（IQR 25.0–57.5），低于可接受范围。Gemini 与 AI-TransLATE 和 ChatGPT 均存在显著差异，而 AI-TransLATE 与 ChatGPT 之间无显著差异。与 Gemini 相比，AI-TransLATE 和 ChatGPT 在满意度、感知的沟通效果以及在临床实践中的使用意愿方面也显著更高。【结论】在模拟 ICU 家属会议中，部分基于语音的 AI 口译工具表现出临床医生报告的可接受可用性，支持进一步研究其在专业口译员资源有限时作为补充口译工具的潜力。未来工作应优先在真实环境中开展验证并评估患者的理解情况，以支持安全且可扩展的实施。

abstract: [Journal of Crohn's & colitis] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly evolving from task-specific algorithms to multimodal foundation models capable of integrating heterogeneous biological and clinical data across the health-care continuum. In inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), this transformation offers an unprecedented opportunity to move beyond fragmented analyses toward a unified understanding and management of disease. Artificial intelligence is emerging as the connective infrastructure linking scientific discovery, therapeutic development, patient care, education, and health-care delivery systems into continuously learning ecosystems. In this viewpoint, we explore how AI may reshape IBD over the next decade through 5 interconnected domains. Advances in multimodal AI accelerate biological discovery by integrating multiomics, spatial biology, and foundation models to identify mechanistic disease endotypes. Simultaneously, AI can shorten the path from molecular discovery to therapeutic innovation by supporting target identification, predicting protein structure, drug positioning, and adaptive clinical trial design. These scientific advances converge at the bedside, where multimodal AI may transform patient care from reactive management to predictive precision medicine through integrated diagnostics, digital biomarkers, real-time monitoring and individualized risk prediction. Beyond clinical care, AI is redefining medical education by enabling adaptive learning, explainable decision support, and democratized specialist expertise, while contributing to sustainable health care through optimized resource allocation, workforce support, and continuously learning systems. Realizing this vision will require robust governance, interoperability, prospective validation, and equitable implementation. If responsibly deployed, AI holds the potential to redefine IBD diagnosis, classification, therapeutic strategies and management within an intelligent ecosystem able to accelerate discovery, personalize care, and improve outcomes for patients and health-care systems alike.
zh_abstract: [《克罗恩病与结肠炎杂志》] 人工智能（AI）正从针对特定任务的算法迅速发展为多模态基础模型，能够整合贯穿整个医疗连续体的异质性生物学与临床数据。在炎症性肠病（IBD）中，这一转变带来了前所未有的机遇，使我们得以超越碎片化的分析，实现对疾病的统一理解与管理。人工智能正成为连接科学发现、治疗开发、患者照护、教育和医疗服务体系的纽带性基础设施，使它们形成持续学习的生态系统。在本观点文章中，我们通过5个相互关联的领域探讨AI可能如何在未来十年重塑IBD。多模态AI的进展通过整合多组学、空间生物学和基础模型来加速生物学发现，从而识别具有机制基础的疾病内型。与此同时，AI可通过支持靶点识别、预测蛋白质结构、药物定位和适应性临床试验设计，缩短从分子发现到治疗创新的路径。这些科学进展在床旁汇合：多模态AI可通过整合诊断、数字生物标志物、实时监测和个体化风险预测，将患者照护从被动管理转变为预测性精准医学。在临床照护之外，AI通过实现适应性学习、可解释的决策支持以及专科专业知识的普及化来重新定义医学教育，同时通过优化资源配置、支持劳动力以及持续学习的系统，助力可持续的医疗保健。要实现这一愿景，需要稳健的治理、互操作性、前瞻性验证和公平的实施。若能负责任地部署，AI有望在一个能够加速发现、实现个体化照护的智能生态系统中，重新定义IBD的诊断、分类、治疗策略和管理，并改善患者和医疗体系的结局。

abstract: [Expert opinion on drug discovery] Drug-induced liver injury (DILI) remains a major translational safety liability, but generic binary prediction does not align well with the decisions faced in modern drug discovery. This Critical Perspective draws on a targeted, non-systematic assessment of peer-reviewed literature, regulatory guidance and public DILI resources covering clinical phenotypes, mechanisms, human-relevant liver models, high-content imaging and omics, exposure-aware bioactivity, applicability domain, nearest-neighbor evidence and AI-enabled prediction. Finally, the authors propose a decision-evidence framework and practical model-card standard. DILI models have historically been judged primarily by global retrospective classification performance. In the future, a model should be decision-grade only when its context of use, exposure assumptions, applicability domain, operating-point performance, external validation, false-negative classes and uncertainty are explicit. Current human-relevant approaches can already support compound ranking and mechanistic follow-up within defined domains. The next frontier is susceptibility-aware prediction that links compound biology with donor diversity, genetics, immune context and longitudinal clinical evidence.

abstract: Offline treatment learning must balance imitation, which stays close to logged evidence but ignores outcomes, against value maximisation, which uses outcomes but drifts toward treatments the records cannot verify. Numerical reinforcement learning strikes this balance during training. For large language models (LLMs), directly using sparse retrospective outcomes for fine-tuning raises challenges of delayed credit assignment and limited evidence for alternative treatments. We present R-LLMC, which strikes the balance at inference for sepsis resuscitation. A behaviour-supervised LLM, decoded into an exact distribution over 25 vasopressor-fluid actions, proposes clinician-anchored candidates; an offline critic selects among them by estimated long-term value. The policy has a closed form for off-policy evaluation, and its rationale is written after selection, so explanation cannot steer treatment. In experiments on held-out MIMIC-III patients, R-LLMC exceeded the clinician reference in doubly robust value by +0.214 (95\% CI 0.091-0.300), with fitted Q evaluation agreeing.
zh_abstract: 离线治疗学习必须在模仿与价值最大化之间取得平衡：模仿贴近已记录的证据但忽略结局，价值最大化利用结局但会偏向记录无法验证的治疗。数值型强化学习在训练期间实现这种平衡。对于大语言模型（LLM），直接利用稀疏的回顾性结局进行微调，会带来延迟信用分配以及替代治疗证据有限的挑战。我们提出 R-LLMC，它在推理阶段为脓毒症复苏实现这种平衡。一个经行为监督的 LLM 被解码为对 25 种升压药-液体动作的精确分布，提出以临床医生行为为锚点的候选方案；离线评价器（critic）依据估计的长期价值在其中进行选择。该策略具有用于离策略评估的闭式形式，其理由说明在选择之后生成，因此解释不会左右治疗。在保留的 MIMIC-III 患者实验中，R-LLMC 的双重稳健价值比临床医生参考高 +0.214（95% CI 0.091–0.300），拟合 Q 评估结果与之一致。

abstract: Surgical resection planning centers on generating executable resection surfaces from anatomical evidence and operative constraints. Medical multimodal foundation models enable anatomical understanding, and segmentation models predict resection regions, but neither translates these capabilities into explicitly constrained, executable resection surfaces. We present GeoSurge, an anatomy-grounded framework that combines mask-derived metrics with structure-aware point-cloud tokens to generate executable, editable resection surfaces. To make resection geometry learnable and editable, GeoSurge maps actions to parametric geometry through a surface-action grammar. Using this grammar, anatomy-oriented and tumor-centered templates generate candidates, which are filtered by hard constraints and semantic deduplication. Training supervision is then derived from candidate-expert geometric agreement and independently recomputed feasibility metrics. At inference, the reasoner uses patient evidence and surgical requirements to select or revise an action, which an independent geometry engine subsequently materializes and verifies. GeoSurge achieves the best overall scores on DeepTumour Liver and CRLM-QA, improving the constraint satisfaction rate from 73% to 100% on CRLM and from 56% to 99% on GeoSurge-Bench.
zh_abstract: 外科切除规划的核心在于依据解剖学证据和手术约束生成可执行的切除面。医学多模态基础模型能够实现解剖学理解，分割模型能够预测切除区域，但二者都无法将这些能力转化为受到明确约束、可执行的切除面。我们提出 GeoSurge，一种以解剖为基础的框架，将基于掩膜得到的指标与结构感知的点云 token 相结合，以生成可执行、可编辑的切除面。为使切除几何可学习、可编辑，GeoSurge 通过一种曲面动作语法（surface-action grammar）将动作映射为参数化几何。利用该语法，以解剖为导向和以肿瘤为中心的模板生成候选方案，再经硬约束和语义去重进行筛选。随后，训练监督信号来源于候选方案与专家几何的一致性，以及独立重新计算的可行性指标。在推理时，推理器利用患者证据和手术要求选择或修订某一动作，随后由独立的几何引擎将其具体化并进行验证。GeoSurge 在 DeepTumour Liver 和 CRLM-QA 上取得了最佳的总体得分，将约束满足率在 CRLM 上从 73% 提高到 100%，在 GeoSurge-Bench 上从 56% 提高到 99%。

title: Refining and Aligning Clinical Reasoning with Health Guidelines via Formal Constraints
zh_title: 通过形式化约束使临床推理与诊疗指南对齐
summary: 提出VerClin框架，将指南转为可执行知识，经四值推理与多专科智能体生成可追溯的临床指导。
key_points: 提取指南条件、排除与优先级为可执行知识
确定性四值推理器保留不确定性
多专科智能体筛选并合成建议
reason: 新颖智能体方法，摘要未见充分验证，中档
abstract: Clinical reasoning from incomplete or conflicting patient evidence must account for low-probability but high-risk concerns while remaining grounded in health guidelines. We introduce VerClin, an explainable framework that extracts guideline conditions, exclusions, recommendations, and priorities into executable knowledge and represents patient conversations as scoped cases. A deterministic four-valued reasoner produces traceable guideline matches while preserving uncertainty and enforcing exclusions. Multiple specialty agents then screen matched guidelines for case applicability, and a consultation model synthesizes accepted guidance through specialty recommendations and a sentence-preserving formal-constraint channel. We present accepted guidance in ascending order of the sum of its priority and trigger-strength ranks, which can surface high-risk guidance with weaker triggers. VerClin outperforms direct generation and Top-5 RAG on HealthBench Hard and HealthBench Professional. On the LLMEval-Med subset, it outperforms direct generation and ties Top-5 RAG. Component analyses further examine semantic closure, example-guided refinement, specialty screening, and constraint-conditioned delivery.
zh_abstract: 基于不完整或相互矛盾的患者证据进行临床推理，必须考虑低概率但高风险的问题，同时仍以健康指南为依据。我们提出VerClin，一种可解释框架，它将指南中的条件、排除项、推荐意见和优先级提取为可执行的知识，并将患者对话表示为限定范围的病例。一个确定性的四值推理器生成可追溯的指南匹配结果，同时保留不确定性并强制执行排除项。随后，多个专科智能体（agent）针对病例适用性对匹配的指南进行筛选，会诊模型则通过专科推荐意见和保留原句的形式约束通道，对被接受的指导意见进行综合。我们按照被接受指导意见的优先级等级与触发强度等级之和的升序呈现这些意见，这样可以使触发较弱的高风险指导意见得以浮现。在HealthBench Hard和HealthBench Professional上，VerClin优于直接生成和Top-5 RAG。在LLMEval-Med子集上，其优于直接生成，与Top-5 RAG持平。组件分析进一步考察了语义闭包、示例引导的优化、专科筛选以及受约束条件调控的输出。

title: ReCAP: Sequential Concept Acquisition with Guarantees under Imperfect Concept Predictors
zh_title: ReCAP：概念预测不完美下带保证的序贯概念获取
summary: 提出ReCAP，在概念预测器有误或弃权时进行序贯概念获取，并给出贪心获取的(1-1/e)理论保证。
key_points: 考虑概念预测错误与弃权
目标函数自适应单调且次模
配合剪枝保持解释简短可靠
reason: 有理论保证的新方法，临床验证有限
abstract: Sequential concept acquisition enables interpretable diagnosis from a compact set of human-understandable findings. Such explanations are useful only if clinicians can trust them, yet most existing methods treat predicted concepts as correct, so a correct diagnosis can rest on incorrectly predicted evidence. We propose Reliable Concept Acquisition with Pruning (ReCAP), which reasons over what the concept predictor reports, including errors and abstentions, and replaces conditional information gain with a label-discriminating objective that separates cases requiring different diagnoses. We prove this objective adaptively monotone and adaptively submodular, yielding a (1-1/e) guarantee for greedy fixed-budget acquisition that degrades boundedly under learned estimates, and combine it with abstention-aware acquisition and diagnosis-preserving pruning to keep explanations short and reliable. Across five medical imaging datasets, ReCAP reduces the share of correct diagnoses supported by at least one incorrectly predicted concept from 27.1% to 9.6% relative to the strongest baseline, while using fewer than half as many concepts and achieving higher diagnostic accuracy.
zh_abstract: 序贯概念获取能够基于一组精简的、人类可理解的发现实现可解释的诊断。只有当临床医生能够信任这些解释时，它们才有用，然而大多数现有方法将预测出的概念视为正确，因此正确的诊断可能建立在错误预测的证据之上。我们提出带剪枝的可靠概念获取方法（Reliable Concept Acquisition with Pruning，ReCAP），它针对概念预测器所报告的内容（包括错误和弃权）进行推理，并用一种标签区分目标取代条件信息增益，该目标可区分需要不同诊断的病例。我们证明该目标具有自适应单调性和自适应次模性，从而为贪心的固定预算获取提供(1-1/e)的保证，并且在使用学习得到的估计时该保证仅有界地下降；我们将其与考虑弃权的获取方式和保持诊断不变的剪枝相结合，以使解释简短且可靠。在五个医学影像数据集上，相对于最强基线，ReCAP将至少有一个被错误预测的概念所支持的正确诊断所占比例从27.1%降至9.6%，同时使用的概念数量不到其一半，并取得了更高的诊断准确率。

title: Interpretable Orthogonal Latent Diffusion with Scale-Selective Uncertainty for Medical Image Super-Resolution
zh_title: Med-PODiff：带尺度选择性不确定性的脑MRI超分辨率扩散模型
summary: 预印本提出基于分块POD的扩散框架，将不确定性分解为粗/细成分，并定义像素级幻觉风险分数用于脑MRI超分辨率。
key_points: 在紧凑可解释的局部系数空间中生成
不确定性分解为总体、粗、细三部分
提出幻觉风险分数Hp
reason: 针对扩散幻觉有新意的方法，预印本，证据有限
abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used for medical image reconstruction and super-resolution, but their samples may contain plausible fine-scale hallucinations that are difficult to identify from the reconstructed image alone. We propose Med-PODiff, a patch-wise proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) diffusion framework for brain MRI super-resolution that performs generative reconstruction in compact and interpretable local coefficient spaces. Unlike pixel-space or learned-latent diffusion models, Med-PODiff uses the POD structure to separate low-rank anatomical variation from fine-detail residual variation, enabling predictive uncertainty to be decomposed into total, coarse, and fine components. Building on this decomposition, we define a pixel-wise hallucination-risk score, $H_p$, that emphasizes regions where fine-detail uncertainty dominates coarse structural uncertainty. On brain MRI, Med-PODiff outperforms representative diffusion baselines in reconstruction quality while producing well-calibrated predictive intervals, with total uncertainty detecting high-error regions at AUROC 0.954. More importantly, the decomposed uncertainty is scale-selective: coarse and fine uncertainty preferentially predict errors at the corresponding scales, with $H_p$ localizing fine error at AUROC $0.906$. Controlled injections and retrospective Cartesian $k$-space undersampling further support fine-detail localization and degradation robustness. The discarded POD tail is only $3.8\%$ of the retained fine-error magnitude, and Med-PODiff improves downstream segmentation consistency while requiring substantially less inference time than pixel-space diffusion.
zh_abstract: 扩散模型越来越多地用于医学图像重建和超分辨率，但其生成的样本可能包含看似合理的细尺度幻觉，仅凭重建图像本身难以识别。我们提出 Med-PODiff，这是一种用于脑 MRI 超分辨率的逐图像块本征正交分解（POD）扩散框架，在紧凑且可解释的局部系数空间中进行生成式重建。与像素空间或学习得到的潜空间扩散模型不同，Med-PODiff 利用 POD 结构将低秩解剖变异与精细细节残差变异分离，从而使预测不确定性可分解为总体、粗尺度和细尺度三个分量。在此分解的基础上，我们定义了逐像素的幻觉风险评分 $H_p$，其着重标示细节不确定性超过粗结构不确定性的区域。在脑 MRI 上，Med-PODiff 的重建质量优于具有代表性的扩散基线模型，同时给出校准良好的预测区间，其总不确定性检测高误差区域的 AUROC 为 0.954。更重要的是，分解后的不确定性具有尺度选择性：粗尺度和细尺度不确定性分别优先预测相应尺度上的误差，其中 $H_p$ 定位细尺度误差的 AUROC 为 $0.906$。受控注入实验和回顾性笛卡尔 $k$ 空间欠采样实验进一步支持了其对细节的定位能力及对图像退化的稳健性。被舍弃的 POD 尾部仅占保留的细尺度误差幅值的 $3.8\%$，并且 Med-PODiff 改善了下游分割的一致性，同时所需推理时间远少于像素空间扩散模型。

title: EnSurv: Deep Generative Survival Modeling with Application to Kidney Graft Outcomes
zh_title: EnSurv：用于肾移植移植物结局的深度生成式生存模型
summary: 预印本基于243,443例UNOS肾移植记录，提出深度生成式生存框架EnSurv，建模移植物失败时间。
key_points: 数据含多区域结构与高右删失率
基于能量评分并结合KM尾部补全
面向器官分配与个体化免疫治疗
reason: 大样本注册数据的新方法预印本，外部验证未知
abstract: Kidney transplantation is the optimal treatment for life-threatening end-stage renal disease, providing significant survival advantages over dialysis. Given the severe shortage of donor organs, accurately predicting the time to premature graft failure is an essential clinical task for optimizing organ allocation and tailoring individualized immunosuppressive therapies. This study is motivated by a comprehensive United Network of Organ Sharing (UNOS) dataset containing 243,443 kidney transplant records with complex multi-region structures and high right-censoring rates. We propose EnSurv (survival engression), a deep generative survival framework designed to capture complex, non-linear clinical covariate interactions for modeling time to graft failure. Within a pre-additive noise model (pre-ANM) family, EnSurv optimizes an energy score augmented with pooled Kaplan-Meier tail completion to handle right-censoring. We identify the pooled-completion target of the objective, establish consistency for its best approximation within the pre-ANM family, and give conditions and error bounds for its relation to true conditional graft survival. EnSurv also provides global explainability through summaries of fitted feature weights and incorporates domain constraints through established clinical directions using a soft gradient penalty. Extensive simulation experiments were conducted to evaluate the performance of the proposed method in comparison with existing methods. Application to the UNOS cohort demonstrates that EnSurv effectively models individual and region-level effects, consistently outperforming baselines across evaluation metrics encompassing discrimination, calibration, and accuracy.

title: The effectiveness of AI-based cognitive behavioral therapy chatbots for anxiety and depression symptoms: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
zh_title: AI聊天机器人CBT对焦虑抑郁症状效果的系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 纳入10项研究共1,301名参与者，荟萃分析评估AI聊天机器人认知行为疗法对焦虑和抑郁症状的作用。
key_points: 检索多个中英文数据库
共纳入10项研究、1,301名参与者
以SMD为效应量，摘要显示对抑郁症状有显著改善
reason: 系统综述，样本较小，异质性未知
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] AI chatbots are increasingly being used to provide accessible psychological support. However, the effectiveness of chatbot-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy for anxiety and depressive symptoms remains uncertain. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of artificial intelligence chatbot-based cognitive behavioral therapy on anxiety and depressive symptoms. A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, PsycINFO, Cochrane Library, CNKI, VIP, Wanfang, and CBM databases was conducted from their inception to July 8th, 2025. Updated search on August 25, 2026. Meta-analysis was conducted using Stata version 18.0 and RevMan version 5.4. The ES for the treatment effect was calculated using the SMD. Ten studies involving a total of 1,301 participants. The results of the meta-analysis showed that the CBT of AI chatbots could significantly improve depressive symptoms at the end of the intervention (d = -0.40, 95% CI: -0.62 ~ -0.17, P = 0.0005). In contrast, the intervention did not significantly improve anxiety symptoms (d = -0.029, 95% CI: -0.145 ~ 0.087, P = 0.623), with no substantial heterogeneity detected (I 2= 0%). The subgroup analysis for depressive symptoms indicated significant effects were observed in participant age stratification, intervention Duration, and Control group intervention. However, some subgroup estimates were based on a small number of studies, so the data should be interpreted with caution. This meta-analysis emphasizes that AI-based chatbots for CBT may have great potential in contributing to the alleviation of depressive symptoms. Given the small number of included studies and the high heterogeneity, the results should be interpreted with caution. More high-quality RCTs are needed in the future to further validate these findings and explore their long-term benefits. https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251089835.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 人工智能聊天机器人正越来越多地被用于提供便捷的心理支持。然而，聊天机器人提供的认知行为疗法对焦虑和抑郁症状的效果仍不确定。本研究旨在评估基于人工智能聊天机器人的认知行为疗法对焦虑和抑郁症状的影响。我们系统检索了 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、PsycINFO、Cochrane Library、CNKI、VIP、万方和 CBM 数据库，检索时间从建库至 2025 年 7 月 8 日。更新检索时间为 2026 年 8 月 25 日。使用 Stata 18.0 版和 RevMan 5.4 版进行荟萃分析。治疗效应的效应量（ES）采用标准化均数差（SMD）计算。共纳入 10 项研究，涉及 1,301 名参与者。荟萃分析结果显示，人工智能聊天机器人的认知行为疗法在干预结束时可显著改善抑郁症状（d = -0.40，95% CI：-0.62 ~ -0.17，P = 0.0005）。相比之下，该干预未显著改善焦虑症状（d = -0.029，95% CI：-0.145 ~ 0.087，P = 0.623），且未检测到明显异质性（I² = 0%）。针对抑郁症状的亚组分析表明，在参与者年龄分层、干预时长和对照组干预方面观察到显著效应。然而，部分亚组估计基于的研究数量较少，因此对数据的解读应谨慎。本荟萃分析强调，基于人工智能的聊天机器人认知行为疗法在缓解抑郁症状方面可能具有巨大潜力。鉴于纳入研究数量较少且异质性较高，对结果的解读应谨慎。未来需要更多高质量的随机对照试验来进一步验证这些发现并探索其长期获益。https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/view/CRD420251089835。

title: Applying the hallmarks of artificial intelligence to genitourinary medical oncology: an evidence-maturity framework for precision cancer care.
zh_title: AI在泌尿生殖肿瘤内科的应用：证据成熟度框架
summary: 结构化叙述性综述，将十项精准肿瘤学标志分类应用于前列腺、尿路上皮和肾癌，并按验证层级描述证据，指出证据参差不齐。
key_points: 引入从概念验证到前瞻干预的验证描述
涵盖影像、病理、分子推断与预后建模
试验匹配基准提供研究机会，证据不均
reason: 综述类上限6档，肿瘤AI证据框架有信息量
abstract: [Frontiers in oncology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly reshaping genitourinary (GU) medical oncology across the cancer-care continuum. In this structured narrative review, we apply the ten-hallmark precision-oncology taxonomy proposed by Chang et al. to GU malignancies. We further define GU-specific hallmark boundaries and introduce study-design and validation descriptors that span proof-of-concept, internal and external validation, prospective clinical evaluation, and prospective interventional evaluation, while distinguishing evidence derived from randomized trials. Across prostate, urothelial, and kidney cancers, AI has shown promising technical performance in imaging, pathology, molecular inference, and outcome modeling. General-oncology trial-matching benchmarks offer additional research opportunities, although evidence remains uneven. Among the examples reviewed, validation designs highly vary, and strong discrimination should not be interpreted as evidence of clinical benefit. We therefore emphasize cohort size, validation design, head-to-head comparator evidence, calibration when reported, and implementation considerations including regulation, model drift, fairness, clinician oversight, cybersecurity, workflow integration, and cost. The next phase of AI in GU oncology will depend on demonstrating incremental clinical utility and patient benefit, not only higher accuracy.
zh_abstract: [肿瘤学前沿（Frontiers in oncology）] 人工智能（AI）正日益重塑贯穿肿瘤诊疗全程的泌尿生殖系统（GU）肿瘤内科学。在这篇结构化叙述性综述中，我们将 Chang 等人提出的十大特征（hallmark）精准肿瘤学分类法应用于 GU 恶性肿瘤。我们进一步界定了 GU 特异性的特征边界，并引入了研究设计与验证描述指标，涵盖概念验证、内部和外部验证、前瞻性临床评估及前瞻性干预性评估，同时区分来自随机试验的证据。在前列腺癌、尿路上皮癌和肾癌中，AI 在影像、病理、分子推断和结局建模方面已显示出有前景的技术性能。一般肿瘤学的试验匹配基准提供了额外的研究机会，但证据仍不均衡。在所综述的实例中，验证设计差异很大，高区分度不应被解读为临床获益的证据。因此，我们强调队列规模、验证设计、头对头对照证据、（如有报告的）校准，以及包括监管、模型漂移、公平性、临床医生监督、网络安全、工作流程整合和成本在内的实施考量。GU 肿瘤学中 AI 的下一阶段将取决于证明其增量临床效用和患者获益，而不仅仅是更高的准确性。

title: Multi-omics causal deep learning reveals regulatory structure while interventions refine perturbation predictions
zh_title: 多组学因果深度学习揭示调控结构并借干预改进扰动预测
summary: 提出CMC-VAE，在80余万CITE-seq细胞上学习基因-蛋白因果网络，并在CRISPR筛选中优于相关性与潜变量VAE基线。
key_points: 在809,130个CITE-seq谱上训练
恢复共表达、转录因子调控子与免疫信号程序
在三个CRISPR筛选中排序优于基线
reason: 有基线对比的新方法预印本，单细胞基础研究
abstract: Inferring gene regulation from single-cell data is difficult because observational measurements cannot distinguish correlation from causation and access to perturbational data, especially with multiple modalities, remains limited. Here we present the Cross-Modal Causal Variational Autoencoder (CMC-VAE), which learns a network linking genes and proteins (gene-gene, protein-protein and gene-protein) in the latent space and maps each connection back onto measured features. Trained on 809,130 observational CITE-seq profiles, CMC-VAE recovers co-expression, transcription factor regulons and immune signalling programs, and learns a sparse cross-modal map enriched for transcript-protein cognate pairs. On three CRISPR screens used during development, it ranks knockout-responsive genes better than correlation and latent-VAE baselines. Fitted to a screen's unperturbed control cells, without perturbation labels, the model translates measured knockout RNA responses into protein responses better than a correlation map and cognate transcripts. The direction of gene-to-gene regulation, however, is not recovered from observational data. On the CITE-seq screens, fine-tuning only the latent network improves held-out response correlation, mainly by learning a response shared across knockouts. On larger Perturb-seq screens, with about 1,000 training perturbations, fine-tuning the latent network learns gene-specific effects that transfer to held-out genes, more so than a gene-level causal model fine-tuned on the same cells, and in simulation, such interventions also restore edge orientations that observational training leaves unresolved.
zh_abstract: 从单细胞数据推断基因调控十分困难，因为观察性测量无法区分相关与因果，而扰动数据（尤其是多模态扰动数据）的获取仍然有限。在此我们提出跨模态因果变分自编码器（CMC-VAE），它在潜空间中学习连接基因与蛋白质（基因-基因、蛋白质-蛋白质和基因-蛋白质）的网络，并将每个连接映射回所测量的特征。CMC-VAE 在 809,130 个观察性 CITE-seq 谱上训练，可还原共表达、转录因子调控子和免疫信号程序，并学习到富集转录本-蛋白质对应配对的稀疏跨模态图谱。在开发过程中使用的三个 CRISPR 筛选上，它对敲除响应基因的排序优于相关性和潜空间 VAE 基线。当模型拟合于某个筛选中未扰动的对照细胞（无扰动标签）时，其将所测得的敲除 RNA 响应转化为蛋白质响应的表现优于相关性图谱和对应转录本。然而，基因到基因调控的方向无法从观察性数据中还原。在 CITE-seq 筛选上，仅微调潜网络可提高留出数据的响应相关性，主要是通过学习各敲除间共有的响应。在更大的 Perturb-seq 筛选上（约 1,000 个训练扰动），微调潜网络可学习到能迁移至留出基因的基因特异性效应，其效果优于在相同细胞上微调的基因水平因果模型；在模拟中，此类干预也能恢复观察性训练所未能解决的边方向。

title: CheekAI: An explainable, deep learning epigenetic aging clock based on lifestyle and health epigenetic biomarker proxies

abstract: The human methylome is poorly understood and, as such, the vast majority of epigenetic aging clocks are unexplainable black boxes. To address this, we created CheekAI, a robust deep learning model that uses lifestyle and health epigenetic biomarker proxies (EBPs) to predict age. Trained using a longitudinal dataset of 25,400 adult buccal DNA methylation samples derived from 14,716 distinct adults, we used principal components and multi-objective optimization to produce a clock that is explainable, reproducible, responsive, and accurate. The Pearson correlation with chronological age is 0.969, the mean absolute error is 2.49 years, and the intraclass correlation coefficient across 679 replicate pairs is 0.990. CheekAI was significantly associated with a plethora of lifestyle and health variables, including resting heart rate, omega-3 intake, ultra-processed food intake, daily step count, resistance training, and time spent in nature. When applied to external saliva and buccal datasets, CheekAI significantly captured a variety of signals, including smoking and oesophageal cancer. CheekAI was also significantly reduced by a multifactorial lifestyle intervention and this reduction was driven by improvements in dietary and metabolic EBPs. This novel artificial intelligence model represents the first instance of a buccal epigenetic aging clock that utilizes EBPs to offer interpretability and actionability.
zh_abstract: 人类甲基化组目前仍所知甚少，因此绝大多数表观遗传衰老时钟都是无法解释的“黑箱”。为解决这一问题，我们构建了 CheekAI，这是一种稳健的深度学习模型，利用生活方式和健康相关的表观遗传生物标志物代理指标（epigenetic biomarker proxies，EBPs）来预测年龄。我们使用来自 14,716 名不同成年人的 25,400 份成人颊黏膜 DNA 甲基化样本组成的纵向数据集进行训练，并采用主成分分析和多目标优化，得到了一个可解释、可重复、有响应性且准确的时钟。其与实际年龄的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.969，平均绝对误差为 2.49 岁，679 对重复样本的组内相关系数为 0.990。CheekAI 与大量生活方式和健康变量显著相关，包括静息心率、omega-3 摄入量、超加工食品摄入量、每日步数、抗阻训练以及在自然环境中度过的时间。应用于外部唾液和颊黏膜数据集时，CheekAI 显著捕捉到多种信号，包括吸烟和食管癌。多因素生活方式干预也使 CheekAI 显著降低，且这一降低由饮食和代谢相关 EBPs 的改善所驱动。这一新型人工智能模型是首个利用 EBPs 提供可解释性和可操作性的颊黏膜表观遗传衰老时钟。

abstract: Rossetti et al. report that hospitalized patients whose care was informed by an AI-based clinical deterioration early warning system (EWS) were 36% less likely to die during a pragmatic cluster-randomized trial when compared to patients on usual care units without the EWS (adjusted hazard ratio [HR], 0.64; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.53-0.78).1 The authors should be applauded for conducting a trial evaluating the effect of an AI intervention on patient health outcomes; more such trials are needed. Several aspects of the study, however, raise concerns that its findings may not accurately reflect the effect of the EWS. First, spillover effects on availability of scarce intensive care unit (ICU) beds could have led to worse outcomes for patients in the control group. Second, EWS-informed clinical decisions may have led to more frequent exclusion of high-risk patients from the intervention group. Either of these concerns could have led to overestimation of AI benefit. Finally, large pre-trial differences in hospital unit mortality rates suggest that unreported cluster-level imbalance or between-cluster variance could also have affected trial results.

title: Effect of a feedback loop on clinical prediction model performance
zh_title: 反馈回路对临床预测模型性能的影响

abstract: Clinical prediction models (CPMs) that guide treatment-initiation, and therefore affect patient outcomes, may create feedback loops when updated using data from patients whose care they influenced. Treatment can alter predictor-outcome relationships and outcome prevalence, potentially reducing model performance. This simulation study aims to quantify this effect using setting parameters based on cardiovascular disease prediction and intervention and assess if including a treatment variable in the model mitigates any performance degradation. In the simulation, models were developed to predict the probability of a binary adverse outcome, guide treatment allocation, and then updated using data containing patients in whom the model was applied. Scenarios varied treatment inclusion as a predictor in the model and the presence of unmeasured confounding. Performance was assessed with calibration-in-the-large, calibration slope, c-statistic, and correct risk assignment relative to treatment threshold. Without unmeasured confounding, excluding treatment as a predictor resulted in miscalibration, but including treatment solves this problem completely. With unmeasured confounding, performance deteriorated even when treatment was included. These results agree with previous findings and illustrate the likelihood that models that guide interventions may experience performance deterioration due to the difficulty of recording treatment and avoiding unmeasured confounders. Causal inference methods combined with risk prediction may help address this problem. Further research is needed on monitoring techniques to allow detection of this issue post-model implementation.
zh_abstract: 用于指导治疗启动、因而会影响患者结局的临床预测模型（CPM），如果使用其所影响诊疗的患者数据进行更新，可能形成反馈回路。治疗可改变预测变量与结局之间的关系以及结局的发生率，从而可能降低模型性能。本模拟研究旨在以基于心血管疾病预测与干预的设定参数量化这种影响，并评估在模型中纳入治疗变量是否能减轻性能下降。在模拟中，研究者建立模型以预测二分类不良结局的概率、指导治疗分配，随后使用包含该模型所应用患者的数据对模型进行更新。各情景在模型中是否纳入治疗作为预测变量以及是否存在未测量混杂方面有所不同。性能通过整体校准（calibration-in-the-large）、校准斜率、c 统计量以及相对于治疗阈值的正确风险分类进行评估。在无未测量混杂时，不将治疗作为预测变量会导致校准不良，而纳入治疗可完全解决该问题。在存在未测量混杂时，即使纳入治疗，性能仍会恶化。这些结果与既往发现一致，并说明由于治疗难以记录且难以避免未测量混杂因素，用于指导干预的模型很可能出现性能恶化。将因果推断方法与风险预测相结合可能有助于解决这一问题。仍需进一步研究监测技术，以便在模型实施后检测该问题。

title: Optimizing Sepsis Treatment via Latent Protocol Inference

summary: 提出生成式潜在方案模型GLPM，以入院状态锚定的潜变量建模治疗轨迹与生存结局，并将治疗优化视为概率逆问题。

reason: 新方法预印本，仅回顾性数据，无临床验证
abstract: Sepsis is a life-threatening medical emergency characterized by high mortality and variable treatment practices. Optimizing treatment from retrospective data is challenging due to sparse, delayed outcomes and complex physiological dynamics. We introduce the Generative Latent Protocol Model (GLPM), a probabilistic framework that structures clinical decision-making through a latent protocol variable anchored on the patient's admission state. This latent variable acts as an information bottleneck, decoupling the generation of treatment trajectories from the prediction of survival outcomes. Unlike methods that rely on value estimation or noisy return-to-go conditioning, our model is trained via maximum likelihood estimation to capture the joint distribution of treatment trajectories and outcomes. At inference time, we treat treatment optimization as a probabilistic inverse problem: we sample latent protocols from a posterior distribution conditioned on a target survival probability. On the ICU-Sepsis benchmark derived from MIMIC-III, our best variant matches or exceeds eight offline baselines on all five datasets, with gains that are statistically significant against every baseline on the most heterogeneous dataset, and offers interpretability through patient-specific counterfactual analysis.
zh_abstract: 脓毒症是一种危及生命的医疗急症，具有高死亡率和治疗实践差异大的特点。由于结局稀疏、延迟且生理动态复杂，利用回顾性数据优化治疗具有挑战性。我们提出了生成式潜在方案模型（Generative Latent Protocol Model，GLPM），这是一种概率框架，通过锚定于患者入院状态的潜在方案变量来构建临床决策结构。该潜在变量起信息瓶颈的作用，使治疗轨迹的生成与生存结局的预测相互解耦。与依赖价值估计或含噪声的 return-to-go 条件化的方法不同，我们的模型通过最大似然估计进行训练，以捕捉治疗轨迹与结局的联合分布。在推理时，我们将治疗优化视为概率逆问题：从以目标生存概率为条件的后验分布中采样潜在方案。在源自 MIMIC-III 的 ICU-Sepsis 基准上，我们表现最佳的变体在全部五个数据集上达到或超过八种离线基线方法，并且在异质性最高的数据集上相对于每一种基线的提升均具有统计学显著性，同时通过患者特异性反事实分析提供了可解释性。

abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] The physical exam remains a fundamental part of the clinical encounter, but physical exam skills have declined over the last several decades. This decline contributes to diagnostic error, overutilization of diagnostic testing, rising healthcare costs, an erosion of public trust, decreased empathy, and physician burnout. As clinicians increasingly turn to generative artificial intelligence to help with cognitive tasks, the information that we gather at the bedside through a history and physical exam has never been more important. Beyond diagnosis, the physical exam builds connection, conveys caring, and helps physicians and patients navigate uncertainty. We need to re-examine the importance of the physical exam in a tech-enabled clinical environment, design low-touch assessments to better evaluate and teach physical exam skills, integrate emerging technology into the modern physical exam, and embrace the power of the physical exam beyond its diagnostic potential. This commentary highlights these issues and suggests several strategies to begin the revitalization of the physical exam.
zh_abstract: [Academic medicine : journal of the Association of American Medical Colleges] 体格检查仍是临床接诊的基本组成部分，但在过去数十年中，体格检查技能有所下降。这种下降导致诊断错误、诊断检测过度使用、医疗费用上升、公众信任受损、同理心下降以及医生职业倦怠。随着临床医生越来越多地借助生成式人工智能来完成认知任务，我们通过病史采集和体格检查在床旁收集的信息变得前所未有地重要。除诊断之外，体格检查还能建立联系、传达关怀，并帮助医生和患者应对不确定性。我们需要重新审视体格检查在技术赋能的临床环境中的重要性，设计低接触式评估以更好地评价和教授体格检查技能，将新兴技术融入现代体格检查，并充分发挥体格检查在诊断潜力之外的作用。本评论强调了这些问题，并提出若干策略以开启体格检查的振兴。

abstract: [Polski merkuriusz lekarski : organ Polskiego Towarzystwa Lekarskiego] Aim: To assess the compatibility of the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act with the right to healthcare via the Ukrainian concept of vital security. Materials and Methods: The study was conducted in 2026 and analyzed 29 legal, policy, and academic sources, as well as European Union and Ukrainian legal and policy documents relevant to artificial intelligence in healthcare, fundamental rights, and patient protection. The study applied comparative legal, formal-dogmatic, and systemic-structural methods. Artificial intelligence tools supported information search and proofreading; Grammarly was used for language editing. Conclusions: The European Union Artificial Intelligence Act's market-based risk model contradicts the absolute, "optimizing" approach of a Beveridge healthcare model like Ukraine. To adapt the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act, countries should examine artificial intelligence in the medical sphere through fundamental human rights rather than commercial metrics.

abstract: [International nursing review] To clarify cognitive health and dementia care as nursing well-being policy and identify policy levers through which prevention, coordinated care, data linkage and governed artificial intelligence may reduce avoidable nursing burden. Cognitive impairment, dementia and delirium shape nursing work through behavioural crises, fragmented information, repeated documentation, family distress, safety risks and moral strain. Although often treated as clinical or ageing-policy issues, these pressures affect workload, violence exposure, retention and well-being. Japan provides an illustrative context where ageing, dementia reform, community-based care and digital health converge. This non-empirical policy analysis was informed by a targeted narrative evidence synthesis. Searches of nursing and health literature published from January 2014 to May 2026 were supplemented by targeted searches of international and Japanese policy repositories and citation chasing. Sources were prioritised by policy relevance, nursing relevance, evidential strength and applicability. Nursing well-being policy is a focused part of workforce policy addressing workload, safety and moral distress, rather than general employment conditions. Prevention and information continuity may reduce avoidable burden; artificial intelligence remains an adjunct requiring evaluation. Policy levers include education, protected care time, coordination, digital governance and safety culture. Cognitive health and dementia care can support nursing well-being when policies connect prevention, person-centred care, interoperable information and cautious technology governance. Nurses should evaluate cognitive health and dementia initiatives using workload, documentation burden, violence exposure and moral distress. Specify nurse-sensitive measures in dementia-service evaluations, resource prevention and coordination time, and assess documentation and alert burdens when procuring digital tools.

abstract: Joint brain tumor segmentation and classification models are computationally intensive, limiting their training on resource-constrained edge platforms and restricting privacy-preserving Federated Learning FL in the Internet of Medical Things IoMT. Existing approaches either perform both tasks on GPU-equipped workstations or support only classification on edge devices. To address this gap, this work proposes a lightweight multitask FL framework for joint segmentation and classification through local edge training. A shared pretrained LiteMedSAM encoder with TinyViT extracts features for a coordinate-attention-based segmentation decoder and a segmentation-guided classification head, eliminating a separate feature extractor. Selective encoder freezing retains 95\% trainable parameters while reducing on-device training costs. The proposed framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory testbed of five resource-constrained edge clients using 1,200 T1-weighted MRI samples. It achieves 94.20\% classification accuracy, 88.53\% DSC, 83.68\% IoU, and 99.87\% ROC-AUC. Its classification accuracy remains within 0.6\% of the GPU-trained baseline of 95.21\% across five FL rounds. The attention and feature refinement modules improve DSC and IoU by 3.82\% and 4.60\%, respectively, with 0.74 GFLOPs of additional computation. On edge hardware, the framework achieves 46.54 s inference latency, 52.8\% CPU utilization, and a peak temperature of 65$^\circ$C without thermal throttling. Its inference latency is observed to be 6.4--10.5 times lower than that of existing frameworks. These results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving joint brain tumor segmentation and classification on resource-constrained edge platforms.
zh_abstract: 脑肿瘤分割与分类联合模型计算量大，限制了其在资源受限的边缘平台上的训练，也限制了医疗物联网（IoMT）中保护隐私的联邦学习（FL）。现有方法要么在配备 GPU 的工作站上执行这两项任务，要么在边缘设备上仅支持分类。为填补这一空白，本研究提出了一种轻量级多任务 FL 框架，通过本地边缘训练实现分割与分类联合。该框架使用带有 TinyViT 的共享预训练 LiteMedSAM 编码器，为基于坐标注意力的分割解码器和分割引导的分类头提取特征，从而无需单独的特征提取器。选择性编码器冻结在保留 95% 可训练参数的同时降低了设备端训练成本。该框架在由五个资源受限边缘客户端组成的实验室测试平台上，使用 1,200 个 T1 加权 MRI 样本进行了实验验证。其分类准确率为 94.20%，DSC 为 88.53%，IoU 为 83.68%，ROC-AUC 为 99.87%。在五轮 FL 中，其分类准确率与 GPU 训练基线（95.21%）的差距保持在 0.6% 以内。注意力与特征精炼模块使 DSC 和 IoU 分别提高 3.82% 和 4.60%，额外计算量为 0.74 GFLOPs。在边缘硬件上，该框架的推理延迟为 46.54 秒，CPU 利用率为 52.8%，峰值温度为 65°C，且未出现热降频。观察到其推理延迟比现有框架低 6.4–10.5 倍。这些结果证明了在资源受限的边缘平台上进行保护隐私的脑肿瘤分割与分类联合的可行性。

title: The Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) Dataset
zh_title: R-ADL：基于雷达的日常活动识别数据集
summary: 发布含八小时以上标注录音的雷达日常活动数据集，覆盖五个地点、八类活动，用于居家老人的隐私友好监测。
key_points: 超过8小时标注记录，8类活动
在两居室公寓的5个位置采集
雷达感知可保护居家隐私
reason: 新数据集但规模有限，预印本
abstract: Monitoring Activities of Daily Living (ADLs) supports safety and well-being for people living at home, especially older adults, and radar sensing is gaining increasing attention in the field of activity recognition for its ability to ensure privacy in the home while also surpassing technical limitations of other sensing modalities. However, radar-based activity recognition remains constrained by the limited availability of large-scale datasets. We introduce the Radar-based Activities of Daily Living (R-ADL) dataset to addresses the gaps identified in existing work: 1) it expands the scale of available data by providing over eight hours of annotated recordings in which a person performs eight distinct activities; 2) it overcomes room configuration limitations by recording from five different locations in a two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment; and 3) it extends beyond primitive actions to focus on high-level ADLs. In addition to the dataset, this paper introduces practical guidance for future ADL dataset construction. We conducted a detailed analysis of how ADLs are prioritized across academic research, health survey tools, and clinical trials to identify clinically significant ADLs. Furthermore, we provide our experimental design, data collection and annotation strategies, post-processing pipeline for forming the R-ADL dataset from raw data, and baseline results on standard machine learning architectures. The R-ADL dataset serves as a valuable resource for advancing ADL recognition systems as we continue building larger and more diverse datasets.
zh_abstract: 监测日常生活活动（ADLs）有助于保障居家人群，尤其是老年人的安全与福祉；雷达传感因能够在家中保护隐私，同时克服其他传感方式的技术局限，在活动识别领域日益受到关注。然而，基于雷达的活动识别仍受限于大规模数据集的匮乏。我们提出了基于雷达的日常生活活动（R-ADL）数据集，以弥补现有工作中发现的不足：1）通过提供超过八小时、由一人执行八种不同活动的带标注记录，扩大了可用数据的规模；2）通过在一套两卧两卫公寓内的五个不同位置进行记录，克服了房间配置的局限；3）超越基础动作，聚焦高层次的 ADLs。除数据集外，本文还为未来 ADL 数据集的构建提供了实用指导。我们对 ADLs 在学术研究、健康调查工具和临床试验中的优先程度进行了详细分析，以确定具有临床意义的 ADLs。此外，我们还提供了实验设计、数据采集和标注策略、由原始数据构建 R-ADL 数据集的后处理流程，以及在标准机器学习架构上的基线结果。随着我们继续构建更大、更多样的数据集，R-ADL 数据集将成为推进 ADL 识别系统的宝贵资源。

title: Online V-Learning with Adaptive Longitudinal Data
zh_title: 自适应纵向数据下的在线V-learning
summary: 为移动健康中分批更新策略的V-learning建立统计理论，处理自适应收集且轨迹相关的数据。
key_points: 针对mHealth中最优动态治疗方案估计
批量更新使数据自适应且患者轨迹相关
在确定性变批量下发展统计理论
reason: 理论性预印本，无临床验证，属增量档
abstract: Reinforcement learning methods for estimating optimal dynamic treatment regimes are increasingly applied in mobile health (mHealth), where treatment decisions are made continually. Luckett et al. (2020) proposed V-learning, which estimates an optimal policy from offline trajectories. In practice, mHealth policies are updated online. Batch updating, in which the policy is re-estimated after each block of new data, is a tractable middle ground between offline learning and updating after every observation. However, because each batch's treatment policy is estimated from data pooled across patients in earlier batches, the resulting data are adaptively collected and patient trajectories are dependent, a setting that offline theory does not address. We develop statistical theory for V-learning in this setting with varying, deterministic batch sizes. For each fixed batch, as the number of patients grows, we establish uniform consistency of the estimated value function, consistency of the estimated policy, a functional central limit theorem over the policy class, asymptotic normality of the estimated value of the learned policy, and a consistent variance estimator. To first order, the online procedure performs as well as an oracle that deploys the optimal policy after the first batch. With the number of patients fixed and the number of batches growing, the estimated value function and policy remain consistent under a persistent identifiability condition. In simulations, as the number of patients grows with the number of batches fixed, confidence intervals attain near-nominal coverage under adaptive assignment and the online procedure closely matches the oracle. With a small cohort followed over many batches, the learned policies improve steadily.

title: ProX-MAD: Aggregating Spatial Context into Representative Proxies for Few-shot Medical Anomaly Detection
zh_title: ProX-MAD：基于代理聚合空间上下文的少样本医学异常检测
summary: 提出基于代理的统一少样本医学异常检测框架ProX-MAD，通过掩码代理注入注意力聚合空间上下文，缓解“一对多”设置下的性能下降。
key_points: 针对一对多少样本医学异常检测
MPIA模块让代理token交叉注意参考patch特征
旨在缓解代理塌缩并提升像素级表现
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未显示充分验证，属增量档
abstract: Few-shot medical anomaly detection (MAD) has largely followed a dataset-specific "one-for-one" paradigm, leaving unified "one-for-many" modeling underexplored. Naively extending existing methods to this setting causes substantial performance degradation, especially at the pixel level. We attribute this to their detection mechanisms: a shared decision boundary becomes unreliable across heterogeneous lesion definitions, whereas a normal-only memory bank cannot adequately cover diverse normal distributions with few references. We propose ProX-MAD, a proxy-based framework that aggregates spatial context into compact, learnable, state-specific proxies for unified few-shot MAD. Its Masked Proxy Infusion Attention (MPIA) module cross-attends proxy tokens to reference patch features and applies proxy-wise masking to retain high-confidence correspondences, mitigating proxy collapse and encouraging diverse proxies that summarize both normal and abnormal references. Across six medical datasets, ProX-MAD exhibits only a marginal performance drop from one-for-one to one-for-many training. Despite being trained only once as a unified model, it also outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods on average even when they use their more favorable one-for-one protocol, demonstrating the practicality of unified multi-dataset MAD.
zh_abstract: 少样本医学异常检测（MAD）长期以来主要遵循针对特定数据集的“一对一”范式，而统一的“一对多”建模仍缺乏探索。将现有方法直接扩展到该设定会导致性能显著下降，尤其是在像素层面。我们将其归因于这些方法的检测机制：共享的决策边界在异质的病灶定义下变得不可靠，而仅含正常样本的记忆库在参考样本很少时无法充分覆盖多样的正常分布。我们提出 ProX-MAD，这是一个基于代理（proxy）的框架，用于统一的少样本 MAD，它将空间上下文聚合为紧凑、可学习、与状态相关的代理。其掩码代理注入注意力（Masked Proxy Infusion Attention，MPIA）模块使代理 token 对参考图像块特征进行交叉注意力，并施加按代理的掩码以保留高置信度的对应关系，从而缓解代理塌缩，并促使代理多样化，以概括正常和异常两类参考样本。在六个医学数据集上，ProX-MAD 从一对一训练转为一对多训练时性能仅有轻微下降。尽管作为统一模型仅训练一次，其平均表现仍优于此前最先进的方法，即使后者采用对其更有利的一对一协议，这表明统一的多数据集 MAD 具有实用性。

title: When does personalization matter? An evidence-to-action beyond smart devices demonstrating the added clinical value of personalization in precision MedTech.
zh_title: 个性化何时重要：精准医疗器械中个性化的临床增值证据

PMD与智能设备、数字疗法有重叠但强调个体数据耦合

zh_abstract: [个体化医学] 精准医学（PM）旨在通过纳入生物学、临床、环境和行为方面的差异，而非仅依赖群体平均值，来改善预防、诊断和治疗。医疗技术（MedTech）提供了一个实用的界面，可将这一方法转化为持续感知、决策支持和个体化干预。我们使用“个体化/精准医疗器械”（PMD）这一术语，指一类概念性器械，它们将个体特异性输入与分析以及器械层面的配置或适应相结合。PMD与智能设备、互联健康和数字疗法有所重叠，但其特点在于将个体化数据与具有临床意义的器械行为明确耦合。本观点文章采用结构化叙述性文献方法。文献调研通过针对PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、IEEE Xplore、Google Scholar以及主要监管/标准来源的定向检索加以扩展，检索涉及精准或个体化医学、生物传感、可穿戴和植入式设备、即时检测诊断、自动给药、数字疗法、人工智能（AI）、医疗物联网（IoMT）、互操作性、监管、网络安全和健康公平的出版物[2025年10月至2026年10月]。优先纳入同行评审的临床研究、系统评价、权威监管指南和国际标准。证据围绕一个器械生命周期框架进行叙述性综合，该框架将个体档案、感知、数据基础设施、分析、执行、临床工作流程、证据产生和治理联系起来。临床证据表明，PMD概念的某些组成部分已经确立。在一项随机试验中，自动胰岛素输注在24周时使目标血糖范围内时间比传感器增强型胰岛素泵治疗增加了14个百分点。在一项针对射血分数降低患者的预设分析中，远程肺动脉压监测使心力衰竭住院减少28%。在苹果心脏研究（Apple Heart Study）中，共纳入419,297名参与者；0.52%收到不规则脉搏通知，在返还可分析心电图贴片的参与者中，34%被确认存在心房颤动。数字疗法和适应性神经刺激进一步说明了软件和植入式系统如何实现治疗个体化，尽管临床可推广性（原文至此截断）

title: The AMPEL Platform: An Open-Source Project for Developing Hospital-Wide Clinical Decision Support Systems under EU-Regulation
zh_title: AMPEL平台：符合欧盟法规的全院级临床决策支持开源平台
summary: 介绍开源AMPEL平台，基于Kafka消息代理的事件驱动分布式架构，用于构建满足欧盟MDR要求的临床决策支持系统。
key_points: 以Kafka为核心的事件驱动分布式架构
面向欧盟MDR的文档与风险管理要求
开源，用于构建全院级CDSS
reason: 系统工程与合规框架，摘要未见临床效果验证，增量档
abstract: As incentives to digitize more and more aspects of medical healthcare are gaining traction, additional medical data is becoming available. A major goal is to use this data to gain further insights, support medical staff, and ultimately improve patient care. This demands sophisticated solutions that can handle current and future vast amounts of data, all without disrupting well-established workflows of care takers. Additionally, the solution must fulfill the documentation and risk-management obligations of the Medical Device Regulation (MDR), which governs whether a device may be used in patient care in Europe. In this context, we introduce the AMPEL platform, an open-source solution for creating clinical decision support systems (CDSS) that fulfil the requirements of the MDR. Centered around a message broker (Kafka), it adopts an event-driven, distributed architecture, allowing for scaling and efficient processing of medical data as it gets generated. Relying on platform-specific events to implicitly describe the platform's interfaces makes it both extensible and agnostic to the hospital information system in use. With these events being defined in the Protocol Buffers format, medically evaluated algorithms can be independently implemented in a variety of programming languages and easily linked to the platform, extending its analytic capabilities as desired. The platform features a basic UI and alert functionality that can be used to gain medical staff's attention and present analysis results in a traceable and explainable fashion. We further show in a use case how the platform was used to build LAMPE, a CDSS developed and operated at University of Leipzig Medical Center. It demonstrates how the platform solution can be used in a complex and already established environment, while acknowledging current limitations and outlining planned developments to overcome these.
zh_abstract: 随着医疗健康更多方面数字化的激励措施不断获得推动，越来越多的医疗数据变得可用。一个主要目标是利用这些数据获得进一步的见解、支持医务人员，并最终改善患者照护。这需要能够处理当前及未来海量数据的成熟解决方案，同时不能干扰护理人员既有的成熟工作流程。此外，该解决方案还必须履行《医疗器械法规》（Medical Device Regulation，MDR）规定的文档和风险管理义务，该法规决定了某一器械能否在欧洲用于患者照护。在此背景下，我们介绍 AMPEL 平台，这是一个用于构建符合 MDR 要求的临床决策支持系统（CDSS）的开源解决方案。该平台以消息代理（Kafka）为核心，采用事件驱动的分布式架构，可在医疗数据产生时对其进行扩展和高效处理。平台依靠特定于平台的事件来隐式描述其接口，因而既具可扩展性，又与所使用的医院信息系统无关。这些事件以 Protocol Buffers 格式定义，经过医学评估的算法可以用多种编程语言独立实现，并方便地接入平台，按需扩展其分析能力。该平台具有基本的用户界面和警报功能，可用于引起医务人员的注意，并以可追溯、可解释的方式呈现分析结果。我们还通过一个用例展示了如何利用该平台构建 LAMPE，这是在莱比锡大学医学中心开发并运行的 CDSS。该用例展示了平台解决方案如何在复杂且已成熟的环境中使用，同时承认当前的局限，并概述了为克服这些局限而计划进行的开发。

title: SwarmLeak: Does Coordination Improve Privacy Attacks on LLM Agents?
zh_title: SwarmLeak：协同能否增强对LLM智能体的隐私攻击
summary: 发布含24个合成群聊场景的红队数据集，比较单一攻击者与四人协同攻击者对受害智能体的信息泄露，协同无优势。
key_points: 场景涵盖医疗、法律、金融、软件
单个攻击者在各受害模型上不逊于群体
同等token预算下比较七种对话策略
reason: 医疗仅为场景之一，合成数据集，规模小
abstract: LLM agents increasingly collaborate in group chats while holding tool access to confidential records, which makes the shared chat an attack surface. It remains unclear whether several colluding attackers extract such information more effectively than one. We introduce SwarmLeak, a red-teaming dataset of 24 synthetic group-chat scenarios across healthcare, law, finance, and software engineering, where attackers pose as colleagues to make a victim agent post protected fields despite an explicit confidentiality policy. With GLM 5.2 attacking five victim models through seven conversational strategies, we compare one attacker with a swarm of four sharing a private channel, matching scenarios, strategies, and a 200,000-token budget that also covers swarm coordination. Swarms show no advantage: a single attacker matches or exceeds them on every victim, and the share of runs leaking any field differs between conditions by at most 14.3 percentage points, whereas changing the victim shifts it from 0% to 99.4%. On the two most vulnerable models, nearly every run leaks under both conditions, but single attackers expose more of the record at first disclosure (85.4% vs. 68.1% of protected fields on Nemotron 3.5 Lightning). Four of the five victims leaked despite the policy. GLM 5.2 retrieved protected data in 64.3% of individual-attack runs and leaked in 0.6%: retrieval does not imply disclosure, but in high-stakes settings even one leaked field can identify a patient or client. At equal budgets, a larger red team is not automatically a stronger one; the victim model matters far more.

title: CLAIMGATE: Cautious On-Device Checking of Spoken Legal and Clinical Claims
zh_title: CLAIMGATE：设备端口语法律与临床断言核查
summary: 提出设备端助手，监听对话、检索官方规则并标注断言为支持、矛盾或未涵盖，采用4-bit 7B模型并倾向于沉默以避免误导。
key_points: 音频留在设备端，保护隐私
模型仅可引用检索到的规则，判定由代码得出
在交通拦查与就诊场景评估
reason: 法律与医疗混合场景，预印本，医疗验证有限
abstract: In law and medicine, a misstated rule can shape a decision before anyone has time to check it. Checking such claims in real time helps only if the checker keeps pace with conversation, keeps sensitive audio on the device, and stays silent rather than mislead. We present CLAIMGATE, an on- device assistant that listens to a conversation, detects checkable claims, retrieves the relevant official rule, and labels each claim as supported, contradicted or not covered, with a citation. CLAIMGATE is designed to fail towards silence: its 4-bit 7B- parameter language model may cite only retrieved rules, and the verdict is derived in code from the claim and rule the model quotes. We evaluate it on traffic stops and medical visits using real official rule text (5,742 Florida and Texas statute subsections; CDC, FDA and MedlinePlus guidance), real transcripts, live speech and author-written gold-labelled claims. On 141 held-out traffic-stop claims, CLAIMGATE reaches 80.1% accuracy and cuts serious errors (a true claim called false, or the reverse) from 20 to 5 compared with the same model without retrieval; deriving the verdict in code alone reduces them from 13 to 5 at no cost to accuracy. The claim gate passes 95.7% of held-out claims and rejects all 30 everyday sentences, and feedback arrives a median 1.86 s after a speech window closes on an 8 GB consumer GPU. On 148 allergy claims, with only the claim gate to rebuild, CLAIMGATE reaches 87.8% accuracy with 5 serious errors, against 20 without retrieval.
zh_abstract: 在法律和医学领域，一条被错误表述的规则可能在任何人来得及核查之前就影响决策。只有当核查者能跟上对话节奏、将敏感音频保留在设备上、并且宁可沉默也不误导时，对此类说法的实时核查才有帮助。我们提出CLAIMGATE，一种设备端助手，它监听对话、检测可核查的说法、检索相关官方规则，并将每条说法标记为被支持、被反驳或未涵盖，同时给出引用。CLAIMGATE被设计为倾向于沉默：其4位量化的7B参数语言模型只能引用检索到的规则，且结论由代码根据模型所引用的说法和规则推导得出。我们在交通拦检和医疗就诊场景中对其进行评估，使用真实的官方规则文本（5,742条佛罗里达州和得克萨斯州法规子条款；CDC、FDA和MedlinePlus指南）、真实转录文本、实时语音以及作者撰写并带金标准标签的说法。在141条保留的交通拦检说法上，CLAIMGATE的准确率达80.1%，与不使用检索的同一模型相比，严重错误（将真说法判为假，或相反）由20个降至5个；仅通过代码推导结论即可将其由13个降至5个，且不损失准确率。说法筛选门通过了95.7%的保留说法，并拒绝了全部30条日常语句；在8 GB消费级GPU上，语音窗口结束后反馈的中位延迟为1.86秒。在148条过敏相关说法上，仅需重建说法筛选门，CLAIMGATE即达到87.8%的准确率，严重错误5个，而不使用检索时为20个。

title: Generating Schema-Aligned Synthetic Dialogues and Measuring Their Diversity
zh_title: 生成与模式对齐的合成对话及其多样性度量
summary: 先采样符合模式的结构化记录，再生成对话与语音，免标注构建对话到记录的配对数据，并度量多样性。
key_points: 先记录后对话，标签先于文本
加入人设、话题计划等变化机制
用嵌入空间度量输出多样性
reason: 方法有新意但医疗证据有限，增量档
abstract: Training or evaluating a model that turns a conversation into a structured record requires paired data, meaning a transcript together with the exact record it should be converted into. Such pairs are expensive to annotate, and in sensitive domains they are also difficult to obtain at all. We therefore build them in the opposite order by sampling a schema-valid record first, then writing a dialogue from it, and optionally synthesizing speech from the dialogue, so the label exists before the text and we need no annotation step. Naively prompting a language model for such dialogues yields small variations of a single conversation, so we add a sampled variation configuration, personas, and a topic plan that orders the fields of the record as explicit mechanisms for variation. We measure the variation that reaches the output through embedding space, where the embedding variance spreads over about two and a half times as many independent directions with our full configuration compared to without (participation ratio 23.3 against 9.2). Two corpora of medical dialogue give values of the same order, with sample size, text length and language being additional factors there. We also show the positive effect of our method in a downstream test, where an 8B extraction model reaches 64.8% field accuracy when fine-tuned on dialogues from our method, against 57.5% from naive generation. We release the generation library and the generated corpus of German clinical dialogues with aligned records.

title: A Description-Derived Drug-Drug Interaction Benchmark Reveals Split-Dependent Molecular Representation Rankings
zh_title: 基于描述构建的药物相互作用基准：表示排名依赖数据划分
summary: 预印本从DrugBank描述中提取六类DDI标签，构建含四种留出方案的基准，比较指纹、预训练序列与图特征表示。
key_points: 将文本描述映射为六个类别标签
四种留出方案，含骨架不重叠评估
分子指纹在高重叠划分中领先
reason: 新基准但规模与影响有限，预印本，增量档
abstract: Drug-drug interaction (DDI) prediction is clinically important and poses a distinct challenge for molecular representation learning. Unlike single-molecule property prediction, DDI requires a predictor to compose two molecular representations into a relational outcome. DrugBank provides curator-authored DDI descriptions rather than ready-made categorical labels, so a categorical prediction target must first be derived from the text. We construct a dataset of DDI pairs by mapping processed descriptions to six text-derived categories and define a benchmark with four holdout regimes that restrict train-test chemical overlap from random pairs to scaffold-disjoint evaluation. We then use this benchmark to compare molecular fingerprints, pretrained sequence representations, and graph-derived features across five seeds and multiple classifier heads. Molecular fingerprints lead the high- overlap random split, whereas graph-derived representations lead the drug- and scaffold-holdout regimes, with the gap increasing as molecular overlap is restricted. Changing the classifier head affects absolute performance but not the relative representation ranking. These results show that representation rankings change with test-set novelty under a fixed description-derived label space.

title: CSC-Mamba: Bridging multimodal convolutional sparse coding and state space models for multi-contrast MRI super-resolution
zh_title: CSC-Mamba：多对比度MRI超分辨率的稀疏编码与状态空间模型
summary: 预印本提出将深度展开的多模态卷积稀疏编码与Vision Mamba结合，用于多对比度MRI超分辨率重建。
key_points: 以参考对比度的共同结构先验引导融合
结合展开网络与Mamba全局建模
面向加速临床MRI协议
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比与外部验证
abstract: Multi-contrast MRI super-resolution accelerates clinical protocols by reconstructing high-resolution (HR) target modalities from low-resolution (LR) inputs, guided by easily acquired reference contrasts. While purely data-driven deep neural networks achieve strong performance via rich representation capacity, they rely on heuristic fusion mechanisms (e.g., naive concatenation or black-box cross-attention) that lack theoretical grounding. Alternatively, model-based deep unfolding networks enforce principled cross-contrast fusion through explicit priors, yet their unrolled steps remain constrained to shallow convolutions, lacking modern deep blocks to capture global context. To bridge this gap, we propose CSC-MAMBA, unifying deep-unfolded multimodal convolutional sparse coding with the Vision Mamba state-space backbone. By fusing common structural priors from the guidance modality via unfolded sparse coding and globally refining contrast-specific representations with a Mamba back- bone, our approach benefits from interpretable, model-guided fusion and long-range spatial context. Experiments on the IXI dataset demonstrate that CSC-MAMBA outperforms state-of-the-art methods in reconstruction quality, achieving up to a 0.62 dB gain in PSNR while remaining computationally efficient.

title: SciFig2Data: A Workflow for Recovering Structured Data from Scientific Figures
zh_title: SciFig2Data：从科学图表中恢复结构化数据的工作流
summary: 提出自动化高通量流程，整合图表检测、复合图分解、OCR过滤、图表分类与多模态LLM重建，从论文PDF中提取结构化实验数据。
key_points: 整合检测、分解、分类与MLLM重建
支持批量执行、缓存与日志记录
面向文献规模的数据获取
reason: 工具型预印本，与医疗关联较弱，评估信息有限
abstract: Scientific measurements reported in scholarly articles are often embedded in compound figures rather than available as machine-readable data. Recovering these measurements at literature scale requires an integrated workflow for figure localization, panel decomposition, chart identification, numerical reconstruction, and experimental context association. We present \textit{SciFig2Data}, an automated, high-throughput workflow for harvesting structured experimental data from scientific PDF repositories. The system integrates multi-scale document element detection, adaptive compound figure decomposition, two-stage OCR-based semantic filtering, Swin-based chart classification, and instruction-guided multimodal large language model (MLLM) reconstruction. It further incorporates directory-level batch execution, caching, and structured logging to support large-scale processing. We demonstrate the workflow on two biomedical literature corpora comprising 605 toxicology and pharmacology articles and 551 lipid nanoparticle (LNP) articles. The pipeline successfully reconstructed 468 and 242 tabular outputs from the respective corpora, illustrating its practical applicability to literature-scale scientific data harvesting. By associating reconstructed measurements with caption-derived experimental metadata, SciFig2Data provides a workflow for transforming graphical evidence in scholarly publications into structured, context-enriched data records for downstream AI4Science applications.

title: CROSS-Calib: Selective Channel Calibration for Ultrasound Reconstruction
zh_title: CROSS-Calib：超声重建的选择性通道校准
summary: 提出利用其他通道预测作参考的通道恢复方法，在波束形成前校准幅相并选择性修复，在体内测试集优于各基线。
key_points: 用其他通道预测校准幅度与相位
上下文门控选择性融合校准测量与预测回波
体内测试及体模实验优于基线
reason: 超声信号处理新方法，预印本，验证规模不明
abstract: Ultrasound imaging provides views of internal tissue in real time for medical diagnosis. However, ultrasound signals may be affected by interference, and correcting errors and removing transient interference while preserving valid echoes remains challenging. We propose CROSS-Calib, a channel recovery method that uses predictions from other channels as references for amplitude and phase calibration, while a gate using context selectively combines calibrated measurements with predicted echoes to retain usable samples and repair unreliable ones. On the in vivo test set, CROSS-Calib outperforms all baseline models under gain errors and transient interference, while phantom tests show that the model restores cyst contrast with echo widths of wire targets close to the clean reference. CROSS-Calib can perform channel calibration and selective repair before beamforming to improve echo usability and image quality.
zh_abstract: 超声成像可实时提供体内组织影像，用于医学诊断。然而，超声信号可能受到干扰，如何在保留有效回波的同时纠正误差并消除瞬态干扰仍具挑战性。我们提出 CROSS-Calib，这是一种通道恢复方法：它以其他通道的预测作为幅度和相位校准的参考，同时利用上下文门控，选择性地将校准后的测量值与预测回波相结合，从而保留可用样本并修复不可靠样本。在体内测试集上，CROSS-Calib 在增益误差和瞬态干扰条件下均优于所有基线模型；体模测试表明，该模型可恢复囊肿对比度，其线靶回波宽度接近干净参考。CROSS-Calib 可在波束形成之前进行通道校准和选择性修复，以提高回波可用性和图像质量。

title: XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management
zh_title: XRL4T1D：1型糖尿病强化学习管理的事后可解释框架
summary: 用SHAP与TimeSHAP事后解释预训练胰岛素给药RL策略，在UVA/Padova模拟器中分析CGM与胰岛素历史输入的重要性。
key_points: 无需重训，评估预训练给药策略
按三个20分钟窗口汇总胰岛素历史归因
通过输入替换检验归因与输出敏感性
reason: 仅模拟器评估的可解释性预印本，无真实患者验证
abstract: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to compare the importance of CGM and insulin-history inputs and summarize insulin-history attributions over three 20-minute windows motivated by insulin-on-board. We assess whether these attributions correspond to policy-output sensitivity through targeted input replacement and compare temporal rankings with TimeSHAP. In all 80 patient-policy-mask-size cases, replacing the highest-attribution inputs changes the normalized insulin recommendation more than replacing the lowest-attribution or random inputs. The highest-attribution insulin-history window is also the most output-sensitive in 115 of 120 patient-policy-scenario configurations, and KernelSHAP and TimeSHAP select the same top window in 111 of 120. Applying XRL4T1D to PPO and G2P2C across 20 virtual patients, we find that both controllers rely predominantly on CGM history, especially G2P2C. However, the distribution of insulin-history importance across recent, middle, and older windows varies by cohort, explainer, and analysis settings, without a consistent separation between controllers. Global feature-attribution rankings remain stable under the tested observation corruptions. These results show why attribution fidelity, temporal reproducibility, and controller-comparison robustness should be assessed separately.
zh_abstract: 1 型糖尿病（T1D）需要终身胰岛素治疗，强化学习（RL）在 UVA/Padova 模拟器中的自动给药方面已显示出前景。然而，RL 控制器的决策仍难以解释。我们提出 XRL4T1D，这是一个事后可解释性框架，用于在不重新训练的情况下评估预训练的胰岛素给药策略。每个策略利用 60 分钟的连续血糖监测（CGM）和已给予胰岛素的历史数据（每 5 分钟采样一次）来推荐胰岛素剂量。我们使用 SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）比较 CGM 与胰岛素历史输入的重要性，并按照以体内残余胰岛素（insulin-on-board）为依据的三个 20 分钟窗口汇总胰岛素历史归因。我们通过有针对性的输入替换，评估这些归因是否对应于策略输出的敏感性，并将时间排序与 TimeSHAP 进行比较。在全部 80 个患者-策略-掩码大小的情形中，替换归因最高的输入比替换归因最低的输入或随机输入更能改变归一化的胰岛素推荐量。在 120 个患者-策略-场景配置中，有 115 个配置里归因最高的胰岛素历史窗口同时也是输出最敏感的窗口；KernelSHAP 与 TimeSHAP 在 120 个中有 111 个选出相同的最高窗口。将 XRL4T1D 应用于 20 名虚拟患者的 PPO 和 G2P2C，我们发现两种控制器主要依赖 CGM 历史，G2P2C 尤为明显。然而，胰岛素历史重要性在近期、中期和较早窗口之间的分布因队列、解释器和分析设置而异，两种控制器之间没有一致的区分。在所测试的观测扰动下，全局特征归因排序保持稳定。这些结果说明了为何应分别评估归因保真度、时间可重复性和控制器比较的稳健性。

title: Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records
zh_title: 对比代理森林：从多模态记录中学习保持完备性的代理变量
summary: 针对近端因果推断，利用临床笔记与生理波形等多模态记录学习混杂因素代理，通过共享信息过滤模态特有风格。
key_points: 近端因果推断需完备的结局侧与处理侧代理
利用两模态间共享信息捕获混杂因素
处理临床文本与生理波形的高维记录
reason: 方法有新意，但摘要无验证信息，预印本，属增量档
abstract: Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies by contrasting the two modalities, given the covariates, on a separate unlabeled sample, and passes them to a proximal causal forest. This contrastive objective has an exact closed-form solution, ridge canonical correlation analysis. We prove that CPF preserves the exclusion restrictions exactly and that its proxies inherit the completeness of the raw records under conditions we characterize. Where style is strong, CPF lowers the error of conditional effects by 10-22% relative to PCA proxies, and on MIMIC-IV it is the only method whose point estimate of warfarin's effect on stroke falls inside the range of randomized trials.

title: Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoders for Scalable Phenotyping of Health Trajectories
zh_title: LCMM-VAE：可扩展的健康轨迹表型聚类潜类混合模型变分自编码器
summary: 提出以类特异线性混合模型为潜在先验的深度生成模型，用于高维、不规则访视的纵向健康轨迹聚类，并推导变分EM算法。
key_points: 潜在先验为类特异线性混合模型混合
轨迹分解为类均值与个体偏差
应对高维测量与不规则访视时间
reason: 有清晰方法但摘要缺乏验证细节，预印本，增量档
abstract: Clustering longitudinal health trajectories requires handling high-dimensional measurements, irregular visit times, and subject-level heterogeneity while retaining clinically interpretable structure. Existing methods address this only partially: latent-class mixed models yield an interpretable, covariate-driven partition but do not scale past a handful of markers, while deep time-series clustering scales at the cost of that structure and generally requires a common time grid. We introduce the Latent Class Mixed Model Variational Autoencoder (LCMM-VAE), a deep generative model whose latent prior is a mixture of class-specific linear mixed models, so that each subject's latent trajectory decomposes into its class mean trajectory and a subject-specific deviation. We derive a variational EM algorithm whose class responsibilities, random effects and mixed-model parameters are updated in closed form, and provide identifiability guarantees under stated conditions. Experiments on simulated and real longitudinal cohorts show that LCMM-VAE returns a partition, a reconstruction of incomplete trajectories and interpretable class-level dynamics at once, while remaining competitive with classical and deep baselines.

title: AI and mixed reality in child and adolescent psychiatry: where we were, where we are, and where we are headed.
source: PubMed · Frontiers in child and adolescent psychiatry
zh_title: AI与混合现实在儿童青少年精神病学中的过去、现状与未来
summary: 该观点文章回顾增强现实暴露疗法的发展，并探讨结合生成式AI智能体的沉浸式平台在青少年心理健康中的应用。
key_points: 回顾从实验室AR到商用头显随机试验的历程
介绍生成式AI智能体驱动的空间角色平台
指出儿童青少年在相关证据基础中严重缺位
reason: 观点类文章，无新数据，精神健康方向略加分
abstract: [Frontiers in child and adolescent psychiatry] Children and adolescents are the first generation to grow up in the era of integration of artificial intelligence and augmented reality (AR) into daily life, yet they are largely absent from the evidence base for the immersive technologies most likely to help them with their mental health challenges. This Perspective explores history of the field from early laboratory AR systems for simple phobias, through randomized trials of augmented reality exposure therapy on commercial headsets, to current platforms in with generative AI agents that animate spatially mapped characters for patients' experience of in vivo interactions. Augmented reality is potentially better matched to youth than virtual reality: the child remains in their own environment, on their own feet, in continuous visual contact with clinician and the caregiver, while feared social and physical stimuli are introduced under graded control. Because these platforms are transdiagnostic and function based, targeting impaired or avoided human interaction rather than a single diagnosis, they extend across anxiety disorders, post-traumatic stress disorder, autism spectrum disorder, early psychosis, and school refusal, and offer an opportunity for standardized, behavioral assessment. There also risks specific to minors: AI-facilitated avoidance, engagement-optimized models that might validate distorted threat appraisal, cultural and developmental bias in AI-generated social behavior, and assent and data governance requirements. The pediatric evidence base is empty because the studies have not been attempted, and filling it requires immersive-technology infrastructure for both research and clinical care in child and adolescent psychiatry, and a generation of clinicians and investigators trained to use it.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in child and adolescent psychiatry] 儿童和青少年是第一代在人工智能与增强现实（AR）融入日常生活的时代中成长的人，但在最可能帮助他们应对心理健康挑战的沉浸式技术的证据基础中，他们基本上缺位。本文（Perspective）探讨了该领域的发展历程：从早期针对单纯恐惧症的实验室 AR 系统，到在商用头显上进行的增强现实暴露疗法随机试验，再到当前采用生成式 AI 代理的平台——这些代理使空间映射的角色具有动态表现，让患者体验现场（in vivo）互动。增强现实可能比虚拟现实更适合青少年：儿童仍处于自己的环境中，双脚着地，并与临床医生和照护者保持持续的视觉接触，同时在分级控制下引入令其恐惧的社交和身体刺激。由于这些平台是跨诊断且以功能为基础的，针对的是受损或被回避的人际互动而非某一单一诊断，因此可扩展用于焦虑障碍、创伤后应激障碍、孤独症谱系障碍、早期精神病和拒学，并为标准化的行为评估提供机会。此外还存在针对未成年人的特有风险：AI 促成的回避、以参与度为优化目标的模型可能强化扭曲的威胁评估、AI 生成的社交行为中的文化和发育偏倚，以及知情同意（assent）和数据治理要求。儿科证据基础之所以是空白，是因为相关研究尚未开展；要填补这一空白，需要为儿童与青少年精神病学的研究和临床护理建设沉浸式技术基础设施，并培养一代能够使用它的临床医生和研究者。

title: Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures
zh_title: 用高斯混合间的Jeffreys散度标记流式细胞术批次漂移
summary: 提出与模型无关的可靠性判据：用高斯混合表示样本，估计其与训练参考分布的Jeffreys散度，在AML的NPM1突变分类器的漂移队列上验证。
key_points: 每个样本用高斯混合模型表示
蒙特卡洛积分估计与训练分布的散度
在真实漂移的AML队列上演示并校准拒识阈值
reason: 方法有新意但场景窄，证据有限的预印本
abstract: Machine learning models for clinical flow cytometry are usually evaluated on data drawn from their training distribution. In routine practice, however, acquisition conditions and reagents may change, potentially making predictions unreliable without warning. We propose a model agnostic criterion for prediction reliability based on a notion of distance from the training distribution: each patient sample is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, and its Jeffreys divergence to a reference fitted on the training data is estimated using Monte Carlo integration. We illustrate our approach on real-life shifted cohorts of acute myeloid leukaemia patients, using a classifier trained to predict NPM1 mutation status. First, we show graphically and statistically that pairwise divergences capture acquisition cohort structure. We then calibrate a rejection threshold on a subset of shifted cohort samples and evaluate it on held-out subjects. Across 20 runs, the misclassification rate of rejected samples was 2.5 times larger than for retained samples. These results suggest that input divergence can help identify unreliable predictions, providing a strong candidate component for abstention frameworks, along with quality control measures and classifier confidence.
zh_abstract: 用于临床流式细胞术的机器学习模型通常是在来自其训练分布的数据上进行评估的。然而，在常规实践中，采集条件和试剂可能发生变化，从而可能使预测在没有任何预警的情况下变得不可靠。我们提出了一种与模型无关的预测可靠性判据，其基于与训练分布之间距离的概念：每个患者样本由一个高斯混合模型（Gaussian mixture model）表示，并使用蒙特卡罗积分（Monte Carlo integration）估计其与基于训练数据拟合的参照模型之间的 Jeffreys 散度。我们使用一个经训练用于预测 NPM1 突变状态的分类器，在真实世界中发生偏移的急性髓系白血病患者队列上展示了我们的方法。首先，我们通过图形和统计方法证明，两两散度能够反映采集队列的结构。随后，我们在发生偏移的队列样本的一个子集上校准拒绝阈值，并在留出的受试者上进行评估。在 20 次运行中，被拒绝样本的误分类率是被保留样本的 2.5 倍。这些结果提示，输入散度有助于识别不可靠的预测，可作为弃权（abstention）框架中一个有力的候选组成部分，并可与质量控制措施及分类器置信度配合使用。
